zh: STOmics Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装 V1.3（载体版）是用于构建新鲜冷冻样本的组织切片全转录本 3' 端文库的试剂套装。本试剂套装采用的 Stereo-seq 时空转录组技术，是一种基于 DNBSEQ 高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场特点的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。Stereo-seq 芯片 T（时空 poly-T 芯片）上载有具有空间坐标信息的捕获探针，与组织切片结合后通过探针原位抓取组织内的 mRNA 分子并进行 cDNA 合成。研究人员通过 DNBSEQ 测序和 STOmics 配套的可视化分析工具，可获取特定样本超高分辨率下的空间转录组信息。
en: The STOmics Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Kit V1.3 (Chip) is a reagent kit used for constructing whole transcriptome 3' end libraries from tissue sections of fresh frozen samples. The Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics technology utilized in this kit is an in situ whole-transcriptome information capture technology featuring high resolution and a large field of view, developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing technology. The Stereo-seq Chip T (spatial poly-T chip) is loaded with capture probes containing spatial coordinate information, which, upon binding to tissue sections, capture mRNA molecules within the tissue in situ for cDNA synthesis. Researchers can obtain spatial transcriptomics information for specific samples at ultra-high resolution using DNBSEQ sequencing and the accompanying STOmics visualization analysis tools.
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 本试剂套装中提供的所有试剂都经过严格的质量控制和功能验证，最大程度上保证了文库制备的稳定性和重复性。
en: All reagents provided in this reagent kit have undergone rigorous quality control and functional validation to ensure the stability and reproducibility of library preparation to the greatest extent.

zh: 行修理，直至肉眼可以观察到植物组织，再调成10 µm 的厚度对植物组织进行修理，直至组织的目标区域出现。根据需求选择切片厚度，通常为10 μm，将植物组织的目标区域切成10 µm 厚的切片，用预冷的毛刷将切片移到切片台右侧靠近边缘处，然后用毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平，如果四周的OCT 翘起，则可以用毛刷将切片轻轻翻转，慢慢平铺在切片台上（切片详细步骤请参考3.2 切片准备）；用干净的粘附载玻片进行贴片，拿起玻片的一端，将玻片正面朝下，对准切片，轻轻按压，肉眼可见切片已经吸附到玻片表面（该贴片方式为热贴），切两片相邻切片分别贴在2 张玻片上，命名为玻片①和玻片②；
en: until the plant tissue is visible to the naked eye, then adjust to a thickness of 10 µm to trim the plant tissue until the target area appears. Select the section thickness according to requirements, usually 10 µm, and cut the target area of the plant tissue into 10 µm thick sections. Use a pre-cooled brush to move the section to the right edge of the sectioning stage, then gently nudge the surrounding OCT with the brush to flatten the section. If the surrounding OCT curls up, you can gently flip the section with the brush and slowly lay it flat on the stage (please refer to 3.2 Sectioning Preparation for detailed steps). Mount the section using a clean adhesive slide; pick up one end of the slide, place the front side of the slide face down, align it with the section, and press gently. The section should be visibly adhered to the surface of the slide (this mounting method is heat mounting). Cut two adjacent sections and mount them on 2 separate slides, labeled as Slide ① and Slide ②;

en: 1) Cover the tissue on each of the two slides with 200 μL of Nuclease-Free Water, let stand for 1 min, then gently discard the water and observe whether there is any tissue detachment;

zh: 1) 用无尘纸擦去组织周围多余液体，用气瓶将组织小心吹干，将玻片平放在实验台，将盖玻片放入装有100% 乙醇的培养皿中，清洗后吹干备用（用气瓶或风扇），此步骤为了减少后续拍照时由盖玻片带入的杂质；
en: 1) Wipe excess liquid around the tissue with lint-free paper, and carefully dry the tissue with an air duster. Place the slide flat on the workbench. Immerse the coverslip in a petri dish filled with 100% ethanol, then rinse, dry, and set aside for use (using an air duster or fan); this step is to minimize impurities introduced by the coverslip during subsequent imaging;
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 2) 取其中一张玻片①，滴加5 μL H&E Mounting Medium 到组织中间（组织面积小于0.5 cm*0.5 cm 可滴加1.5 μL），用清洗晾干后的盖玻片封片（注意不要带入气泡），准备拍照；
en: 2) Take one slide ①, add 5 μL of H&E Mounting Medium to the center of the tissue (if the tissue area is less than 0.5 cm x 0.5 cm, 1.5 μL may be added), mount with the cleaned and dried coverslip (ensuring no air bubbles are introduced), and prepare for imaging;
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 4)  在载物台上滴1-2 μL 水，将载玻片置于水滴上方起到固定作用。打开显微镜，在显微镜控制软件上新建文件夹，注明相关信息，选择透射光，在DAPI通道下拍照，观察玻片①中的组织是否有自发荧光，并与玻片②中的FB 染色法组织成像作对比（拍照步骤参考3.6，注意只需要在DAPI 通道拍照即可）；
en: 4) Pipette 1-2 μL of water onto the stage and place the glass slide over the water droplet to secure it. Turn on the microscope, create a new folder in the microscope control software, label it with relevant information, select transmitted light, and capture images under the DAPI channel. Observe whether the tissue on slide ① exhibits autofluorescence, and compare it with the imaging of the tissue stained with the FB staining method on slide ② (refer to 3.6 for imaging steps; note that imaging only under the DAPI channel is required);
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 可分别用10X 和20X 物镜观察组织和细胞形态，如10X 物镜下组织细胞形态满足后续分析需求，则在正式实验中可选择用10X 物镜拍摄（可在拍照环节节省时间），图像无需转换即可QC；若对图像分辨率要求较高，则在正式实验中可选择用20X 物镜拍摄，此时需要用脚本将20 倍图像压缩为10 倍图像后才能QC。
en: Tissue and cell morphology can be observed using 10X and 20X objective lenses, respectively. If the tissue and cell morphology under a 10X objective lens meet the requirements for downstream analysis, a 10X objective lens can be selected for imaging in the formal experiment (which can save time during the imaging step), and the images do not require conversion for QC. If higher image resolution is required, a 20X objective lens can be selected for imaging in the formal experiment, in which case a script must be used to compress the 20X images to 10X images before QC.
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 2) 提前将一个金属浴或其他同等功能仪器温度设置到37℃，PCR 仪程序为37℃∞（PCR 仪需要装载PCR 适配器（adaptor），无需热盖）；
en: 2) Pre-set a metal bath or an equivalent instrument to 37°C. Set the PCR instrument program to 37°C for ∞ (the PCR instrument must be equipped with a PCR adapter and does not require a heated lid).
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 3) 将配制好的1X 透化试剂工作液放在金属浴上回温1 min，将玻片放置在金属浴或PCR 适配器（adaptor）上，取100-200 μL 1X 透化试剂工作液滴加在组织上，直至液体完全覆盖到组织，此时立即开始计时，并观察组织形态，记录组织脱片时间，该时间即为透化时间上限，建议观察时间为30 min，若刚滴上1X 透化试剂工作液组织就开始脱片，则在做正式实验时不能进行透化步骤。
en: 3) Place the prepared 1X permeabilization reagent working solution on a metal bath to warm up for 1 min. Place the slide on the metal bath or PCR adapter. Pipette 100-200 μL of 1X permeabilization reagent working solution onto the tissue until the tissue is completely covered by the liquid. Start timing immediately and observe the tissue morphology. Record the time of tissue detachment, which is the upper limit for permeabilization time. The recommended observation time is 30 min. If the tissue begins to detach as soon as the 1X permeabilization reagent working solution is added, the permeabilization step cannot be performed in the formal experiment.
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 预实验是保障正式实验成功率的关键步骤，强烈建议所有植物样本先完成预实验；染色方式选择可参考《植物测试参考样本目录》，若《植物测试参考样本目录》内已有该样本染色方式建议，仍需要进行预实验以观察组织脱片情况，但可省去拍照步骤。
en: The pre-experiment is a critical step to ensure the success rate of the formal experiment. It is strongly recommended that all plant samples first complete a pre-experiment. For the selection of the staining method, you may refer to the "Plant Test Reference Sample Catalog". If the "Plant Test Reference Sample Catalog" already contains suggestions for the staining method for the sample, a pre-experiment is still required to observe tissue detachment, but the photography step can be omitted.
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 若组织块较大或含水量极高，可延长平衡时间至 60 min，但需避免过度复温（防止OCT 软化、组织水分融化，切割时因硬度不足、表面张力改变及温度梯度应力导致切片卷曲）。不可从 −80℃冰箱取出后立即切片，否则会因组织块温度极低，与切片机温度存在巨大温差，导致组织内部冰晶快速膨胀或重新结晶，加剧细胞结构破坏（尤其是含水量高的组织，冰晶损伤更为明显）；另外OCT 包埋剂在极低温下会变得过硬和易碎；

Do not proceed with sectioning immediately after removal from a −80°C freezer; otherwise, the extremely low temperature of the tissue block compared to the cryostat temperature will result in a significant temperature difference, causing rapid expansion or recrystallization of internal ice crystals and exacerbating the destruction of cellular structure (especially in tissues with high water content, where ice crystal damage is more pronounced); additionally, the OCT embedding medium becomes excessively hard and brittle at extremely low temperatures;

zh: 1) 粗修：去除多余 OCT，暴露组织表面。首先设置切片机参数，将切片厚度调至40 μm；然后缓慢摇动切片机手轮，从组织块顶部开始切削，每次进刀幅度均匀，观察到白色 OCT 逐渐被切除，直至暴露组织边缘（组织颜色通常与 OCT 不同）。
en: 1) Rough trimming: Remove excess OCT to expose the tissue surface. First, set the microtome parameters to a section thickness of 40 μm; then, slowly turn the microtome handwheel to begin cutting from the top of the tissue block, ensuring a uniform advance each time, and observe as the white OCT is gradually removed until the tissue edge is exposed (the tissue color is typically different from the OCT).
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 2) 精修：平整组织表面，确保切片质量。首先调整切片机参数，将切片厚度调至10 μm，后缓慢摇动切片机手轮，缓慢进刀，每次切削 1~2 层，直至组织完全暴露。组织暴露后，继续切片，建议先用载玻片对修片切出的切片贴片，染色（适配植物的染料都可以）并进行观察（依据经验，可使用显微镜或体视镜），看是否已经到最佳切面；若尚未找到最佳切面，可继续切片，直至找到最佳的切面，切片并准备贴芯片。
en: 2) Fine trimming: Level the tissue surface to ensure section quality. First, adjust the microtome parameters to a section thickness of 10 μm, then slowly turn the microtome handwheel and advance slowly, cutting 1–2 layers at a time until the tissue is fully exposed. After the tissue is exposed, continue sectioning. It is recommended to first mount the sections from the trimming on microscope slides, stain them (any dye suitable for plants can be used), and observe them (based on experience, a microscope or stereomicroscope can be used) to check if the optimal sectioning plane has been reached; if the optimal sectioning plane has not yet been found, continue sectioning until it is reached, then section and prepare for chip mounting.
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: ・	  每一种组织适合的切片温度都不一样，需要多尝试。对于植物样本，建议设置
en: - The optimal sectioning temperature varies for each type of tissue and requires experimentation. For plant samples, it is recommended to set
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: 冻头温度比箱体温度低1℃，而具体的温度要根据环境温度进行调整。例如，在 STOmics R&D 实验室（温度24℃ 、湿度53% ）实际操作中，某植物根，设置冻头−18℃，箱体−17℃，沿着组织纹路切片，可切出较完整切片；某植物茎，设置冻头−20℃、箱体−19℃，可切出较完整切片；
en: the chuck temperature 1℃ lower than the chamber temperature, and the specific temperatures should be adjusted based on the ambient temperature. For example, in actual operations at the STOmics R&D laboratory (temperature 24℃, humidity 53%), for a certain plant root, the chuck was set to −18℃ and the chamber to −17℃, allowing relatively intact sections to be cut along the tissue grain; for a certain plant stem, the chuck was set to −20℃ and the chamber to −19℃, allowing relatively intact sections to be cut;
source_manual: STOG01026_时空转录组FF_V1.3_植物_实验操作指南

zh: ・	 对于易和OCT 分离的组织，切片无法改变，需改良包埋方法。

zh: 1)  连续切取组织切片（根据载体上的芯片数量进行调整），用细毛刷将冷冻切片轻轻展开铺平整，将冷 冻切片移到切片台右侧靠近边缘处，每张切片放置间隔距离大于载体宽度；

zh: 本说明书是使用DNBSEQ-T7RS 可视化试剂套装进行测序操作的作业指导书，内容包括制备DNA 纳米球（DNB），准备载片，可视化试剂盒组分、存储环境及使用方法，测序上机操作以及测序完成后的仪器维护等。
en: This manual provides operating instructions for sequencing procedures using the DNBSEQ-T7RS Visualization Kit. It covers the preparation of DNA nanoballs (DNB), preparation of slides, components, storage conditions, and usage of the visualization kit, instrument operation for sequencing, and post-sequencing instrument maintenance, etc.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 本产品是用于测定时空文库序列的通用试剂盒，与基因测序仪（DNBSEQ-T7RS）配合使用，完成高通量测序并获取样本序列信息。本试剂套装仅供科研使用，不能用于临床诊断。
en: This product is a universal kit for sequencing spatial transcriptomic libraries. It is used in conjunction with the gene sequencer (DNBSEQ-T7RS) to perform high-throughput sequencing and obtain sample sequence information. This kit is for research use only and cannot be used for clinical diagnosis.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 本试剂套装使用联合探针锚定聚合技术（cPAS），通过将DNA 分子锚和荧光探针在DNA纳米球（DNB）上进行聚合，并利用高分辨率成像系统对光信号进行采集，光信号经过数字化处理后获得高质量高准确度的样本序列信息。
en: This reagent kit utilizes Combinatorial Probe Anchor Synthesis (cPAS) technology to polymerize DNA molecular anchors and fluorescent probes on DNA nanoballs (DNBs). Optical signals are collected using a high-resolution imaging system and then digitally processed to obtain high-quality, high-accuracy sample sequence information.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 本试剂套装适用于Stereo-seq 16 Barcode 建库试剂盒（货号：101KL160）构建的时空转录组FF V1.3 文库、时空转录组FFPE 文库、时空蛋白转录组Stereo-CITE V1.1 的转录组文库（CITE V1.1-cDNA）和抗体衍生标签（ADT）文库（CITE V1.1-ADT）。
en: This reagent set is applicable to Stereo-seq Transcriptomics FF V1.3 libraries, Stereo-seq Transcriptomics FFPE libraries, and transcriptome libraries (CITE V1.1-cDNA) and antibody-derived tag (ADT) libraries (CITE V1.1-ADT) for Stereo-seq protein transcriptomics Stereo-CITE V1.1, constructed using the Stereo-seq 16 Barcode Library Construction Kit (Cat. No.: 101KL160).
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 当测序正在进行时，控制软件自动调用basecall 软件分析，并输出测序数据到指定位置用于二次分析。
en: When sequencing is in progress, the control software automatically calls the basecalling software for analysis, and outputs the sequencing data to a specified location for secondary analysis.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 在测序过程中，测序总循环数是按照所选择的测序读长执行的。如PE25+62 测序，按照一链25 循环，二链62 循环（7-9 循环暗反应），共计84 循环执行，最后得到84 循环的序列数据。标签序列的10 循环需要额外进行计算。
en: During the sequencing process, the total number of sequencing cycles is performed according to the selected sequencing read length. For example, for PE25+62 sequencing, it is performed with 25 cycles for Read 1 and 62 cycles for Read 2 (including 7-9 cycles of dark reactions), totaling 84 cycles, and 84 cycles of sequence data are obtained at the end. The 10 cycles of the tag sequence require additional calculation.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 本试剂盒适用于时空转录组FF V1.3 文库、时空转录组FFPE 文库测序、时空蛋白转录组CITE V1.1-cDNA 文库和抗体衍生标签CITE V1.1-ADT 文库，文库为双链DNA。FFPE 文库插入片段范围在150 bp~1000 bp，同时主带集中在±100 bp 以内。FF V1.3 文库插入片段范围在200 bp~600 bp，同时主带集中在±100 bp 以内。CITE V1.1-cDNA 文库插入片段范围在200 bp~600 bp，同时主带集中在±100 bp 以内。CITE V1.1-ADT 文库插入片段范围在200 bp~260 bp。
en: This kit is applicable to the Stereo-seq Transcriptomics FF V1.3 library, Stereo-seq Transcriptomics FFPE library sequencing, Stereo-seq CITE V1.1-cDNA library, and CITE V1.1-ADT library. These libraries are double-stranded DNA. The insert size range for the FFPE library is 150 bp to 1000 bp, with the main band concentrated within ±100 bp. The insert size range for the FF V1.3 library is 200 bp to 600 bp, with the main band concentrated within ±100 bp. The insert size range for the CITE V1.1-cDNA library is 200 bp to 600 bp, with the main band concentrated within ±100 bp. The insert size range for the CITE V1.1-ADT library is 200 bp to 260 bp.

zh: 根据具体应用所需的数据量，测序读长及测序Barcode 等信息决定可pooling 在一起上机的样本量。建议样本在DNB 制备完后，先定量DNB，再pooling DNB。由于每个Barcode 产出的数据量会有偏差，建议所需的总数据量不超过理论数据产量的90%。
en: Determine the number of samples that can be pooled together for sequencing based on the data volume required by the specific application, sequencing read length, and sequencing Barcode information. It is recommended to quantify the DNBs after DNB preparation is completed, and then pool the DNBs. Since the data volume produced by each Barcode may vary, it is recommended that the required total data volume does not exceed 90% of the theoretical data yield.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 对于有特殊测序深度要求的，可以适当增加或减少pooling的样本数量。
en: For projects with specific sequencing depth requirements, the number of pooled samples can be increased or decreased appropriately.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 例如：若总数量为3500 M，每个样本需要380 M 的数据量，建议每张载片最多同时测序 8 个样本。
en: For example: If the total capacity is 3500 M and each sample requires 380 M of data, it is recommended to sequence no more than 8 samples per flow cell simultaneously.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 每一个cycle 中，平衡的碱基组成对于好的测序质量来说非常重要，建议每个cycle 的A，C，G，T 四个碱基的相对含量均不低于12.5%。
en: In each cycle, balanced base composition is crucial for good sequencing quality. It is recommended that the relative content of each of the four bases (A, C, G, and T) in every cycle be no less than 12.5%.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: y 检查已经pooling 样本的Barcode，若某个碱基的相对含量在5~12.5% 间，可以风险上机。
en: Check the Barcode of the pooled samples. If the relative content of any base is between 5% and 12.5%, it can be sequenced at your own risk.
source_manual: DNBSEQ-T7RS时空可视化试剂套装（T7_STO_FCL_PE75）使用说明书

zh: 若低于5%，则不建议上机，需重新规划pooling 方案。每个cycle，只有碱基含量相对较平衡时，才能达到最佳测序质量。
en: If it is lower than 5%, it is not recommended for sequencing, and the pooling scheme needs to be re-planned. Optimal sequencing quality can only be achieved when the base content is relatively balanced in each cycle.

zh: 本产品说明书是使用MGISEQ-2000RS 时空可视化试剂套装进行测序操作的作业指导书，内容包括DNA 纳米球（DNB）的制备及载片的准备，可视化试剂套装组分、存储环境及使用方法，测序上机操作以及测序完成后的仪器维护等。
en: This manual serves as an operation guide for performing sequencing with the MGISEQ-2000RS spatial visualization reagent kit, covering the preparation of DNA nanoballs (DNB) and slides, the components, storage conditions, and usage methods of the visualization reagent kit, sequencing loading operations, and post-sequencing instrument maintenance.
source_manual: H-020-000915-00_MGISEQ-2000RS_时空可视化试剂套装使用说明书

zh: 本产品是用于测定时空文库序列的通用试剂盒，与基因测序仪(MGISEQ-2000RS)配合使用，完成高通量测序并获取样本序列信息。本试剂套装仅供科研使用，不能用于临床诊断。
en: This product is a universal kit used for determining spatial library sequences, utilized in conjunction with a gene sequencer (MGISEQ-2000RS) to complete high-throughput sequencing and obtain sample sequence information. This reagent set is for research use only and cannot be used for clinical diagnosis.
source_manual: H-020-000915-00_MGISEQ-2000RS_时空可视化试剂套装使用说明书

zh: 本试剂套装使用联合探针锚定聚合技术（cPAS），通过将DNA 分子锚和荧光探针在DNA纳米球（DNB）上进行聚合，并利用高分辨率成像系统对光信号进行采集，光信号经过数字化处理后获得高质量高准确度的样本序列信息。
en: This reagent set utilizes Combinatorial Probe-Anchor Synthesis (cPAS) technology, where DNA anchors and fluorescent probes are polymerized on DNA nanoballs (DNBs) and light signals are captured using a high-resolution imaging system to obtain high-quality and high-accuracy sample sequence information after digital processing.
source_manual: H-020-000915-00_MGISEQ-2000RS_时空可视化试剂套装使用说明书

zh: 本试剂套装适用于Stereo-seq 16 Barcode 建库试剂盒（货号：101KL160）构建的时空转录组FF V1.3 文库、时空转录组FFPE 文库和抗体衍生标签（ADT）文库（ CITE V1.1-ADT）。
en: This reagent kit is suitable for Stereo-seq Transcriptomics FF V1.3 libraries, Stereo-seq Transcriptomics FFPE libraries, and Antibody-Derived Tag (ADT) libraries (CITE V1.1-ADT) constructed with the Stereo-seq 16 Barcode Library Construction Kit (Cat. No.: 101KL160).
source_manual: H-020-000915-00_MGISEQ-2000RS_时空可视化试剂套装使用说明书

zh: 当测序正在进行时，控制软件自动调用basecall 软件分析，并输出测序数据到指定位置用于二次分析。
en: During sequencing, the control software automatically invokes the basecalling software for analysis and outputs the sequencing data to a designated location for secondary analysis.
source_manual: H-020-000915-00_MGISEQ-2000RS_时空可视化试剂套装使用说明书

zh: 在测序过程中，测序循环数是按照所选择的测序读长执行的。例如，PE25+59 测序是按照一链25 循环，二链59 循环，共计84 循环执行，最后得到84 循环的序列数据。标签序列的10 循环数需要额外进行计算。
en: During the sequencing process, the number of sequencing cycles is executed according to the selected sequencing read length. For example, PE25+59 sequencing is executed with 25 cycles for Read 1 and 59 cycles for Read 2, totaling 84 cycles, resulting in 84 cycles of sequence data. The 10 cycles for the barcode sequence need to be calculated separately.
source_manual: H-020-000915-00_MGISEQ-2000RS_时空可视化试剂套装使用说明书

en: The DNA Polymerase Mix and dNTPs Mix are packed in separate tubes along with the sequencing reagent reservoir. Before starting sequencing, add an appropriate amount of DNA Polymerase Mix and dNTPs Mix into wells No. 1 and No. 2 of the sequencing reagent reservoir, respectively. Additionally, the MDA Enzyme is a critical reagent for PE sequencing second strand generation and must be added to well No. 15 before starting sequencing. If the reagent reservoir has been prepared but cannot be loaded onto the sequencer immediately, refer to "Kit Storage" on page 38.

zh: STOmics Stereo-CITE 蛋白转录组试剂套装能够在同一张组织切片上，实现全转录本和超高重蛋白的共同检测，并且蛋白检测不影响转录组的捕获。本试剂套装采用的 Stereo-seq 时空转录组技术，是一种基于DNBSEQ 高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。Stereo-seq 芯片 T（时空 poly-T 芯片）上装载具有空间坐标信息的捕获探针，通过一系列生化流程，探针能够原位抓取组织内的mRNA 分子和抗体衍生标签（ADT），并进行 cDNA 合成，通过测序和配套的可视化系统，获取全视场样本的转录组和多蛋白空间分布信息。
en: The STOmics Stereo-CITE protein-transcriptome reagent kit enables the co-detection of the whole transcriptome and ultra-high multiplex proteins on the same tissue section, and protein detection does not affect transcriptome capture. The Stereo-seq spatiotemporal transcriptomic technology used in this kit is an in situ whole-transcriptome information capture technology developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing technology, featuring high resolution and a large field of view. The Stereo-seq chip T (spatiotemporal poly-T chip) is loaded with capture probes containing spatial coordinate information. Through a series of biochemical processes, the probes can capture mRNA molecules and antibody-derived tags (ADT) within the tissue in situ and perform cDNA synthesis. Through sequencing and the accompanying visualization system, the transcriptome and multi-protein spatial distribution information of the full-field sample can be obtained.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 本试剂套装中提供的所有试剂都经过严格的质量控制和功能验证，最大程度上保证了文库制备的稳定性和重复性。
en: All reagents provided in this kit have undergone strict quality control and functional verification, ensuring the stability and reproducibility of library preparation to the greatest extent.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 同型对照抗体是与一抗保持相似特性但缺乏特异性靶标的抗体。同型对照抗体常被作为阴性对照，用来帮助分辨非特异性背景信号和特异的抗体信号。同型对照抗体的选择应与一抗的种属和类别相同，包括轻链。
en: An isotype control antibody is an antibody that maintains similar properties to the primary antibody but lacks a specific target. Isotype control antibodies are often used as negative controls to help distinguish between non-specific background signals and specific antibody signals. The selection of an isotype control antibody should match the species and isotype of the primary antibody, including the light chain.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 例如，如图一，TotalSeq TM -A0007 anti-human CD274 （B7-H1, PD-L1）抗体的同种型（Isotype）为 Mouse IgG2b κ，那么进行此种抗体的检测时，就需要加入 TotalSeq TM -A0092 Mouse IgG2b, κ isotype Ctrl Antibody。具体加入同型对照抗体的种类需要参考所加入的 TotalSeqTM-A 一抗的种类来确定。另外需要注意，如果试剂盒搭配 TotalSeq TM -A Mouse Universal Cocktail, V1.0 （Biolegend, Cat. No. 199901）和 TotalSeq TM -A Human Universal Cocktail, V1.0 （Biolegend, Cat. No. 399907）使用，则无需加入同型对照抗体，因为这两款Cocktail 中已经加入了同型对照抗体。
en: For example, as shown in Figure 1, the isotype of the TotalSeq™-A0007 anti-human CD274 (B7-H1, PD-L1) antibody is Mouse IgG2b κ; therefore, when performing detection with this antibody, it is necessary to add the TotalSeq™-A0092 Mouse IgG2b, κ isotype Ctrl Antibody. The specific type of isotype control antibody to be added must be determined by referring to the type of TotalSeq™-A primary antibody used. Additionally, it should be noted that if the kit is used in conjunction with the TotalSeq™-A Mouse Universal Cocktail, V1.0 (Biolegend, Cat. No. 199901) and TotalSeq™-A Human Universal Cocktail, V1.0 (Biolegend, Cat. No. 399907), there is no need to add an isotype control antibody, as it is already included in these two cocktails.

zh: Stereo-seq 芯片P/T 载体装于真空密封的铝袋中，冷链运输。收到产品后须立即将未开封的Stereo-seq 芯片P/T 载体储存在−20℃或4℃。若拆袋后未使用，需重新干燥密封并储存在−20℃或4℃。
en: Stereo-seq P/T chip substrates are vacuum-sealed in aluminum bags and shipped under cold chain conditions. Upon receipt, unopened Stereo-seq P/T chip substrates must be stored immediately at −20°C or 4°C. If a bag has been opened but the substrate not used, it must be re-dried, resealed, and stored at −20°C or 4°C.

zh: •	 实验前请熟悉需使用的各种仪器的注意事项并掌握其操作方法。
en: • Before conducting experiments, please familiarize yourself with the precautions for the instruments to be used and master their operation methods.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: •	 本说明书提供的实验流程是通用的，实际操作中可根据具体的实验设计、样本特征、测序应用和设备进行实验流程、反应参数的调整，以优化性能和效率。
en: • The experimental workflow provided in this manual is general; in practice, the workflow and reaction parameters may be adjusted based on specific experimental designs, sample characteristics, sequencing applications, and equipment to optimize performance and efficiency.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: •	 推荐使用前将各试剂组分提前取出，将酶类组分瞬时离心后置于冰上备用，并将其他组分置于室温解冻。解冻后轻柔地上下颠倒数次使其充分混匀，瞬时离心后置于冰上备用。
en: • It is recommended to remove all reagent components in advance before use. Briefly centrifuge the enzyme components and place them on ice, while thawing other components at room temperature. After thawing, gently invert several times to mix thoroughly, briefly centrifuge, and place on ice for later use.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: •	 为避免样本交叉污染，推荐使用带滤芯的吸头，吸取不同样本时请更换吸头。
en: • To avoid sample cross-contamination, it is recommended to use pipette tips with filters and to change tips when aspirating different samples.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: •	 推荐把PCR 仪温度预热至反应温度。
en: • It is recommended to preheat the PCR instrument to the reaction temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: •	 应避免皮肤和眼睛直接接触样本及试剂，切勿吞咽样本及试剂，一旦发生意外请立即用大量清水冲洗并及时就医。
en: • Avoid direct contact of samples and reagents with skin and eyes; do not swallow samples or reagents. In case of accidental exposure, rinse immediately with plenty of water and seek medical attention.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: •	 所有样本和各种废弃物均应按相关法规规定处理。
en: • All samples and waste materials should be handled in accordance with relevant regulations.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 如果试剂盒搭配TotalSeqTM -A Mouse Universal Cocktail, V1.0 （Biolegend, Cat. No.199901）和TotalSeqTM -A Human Universal Cocktail, V1.0 （Biolegend, Cat. No.399907）使用，则可以跳过抗体滴定/IF 预实验，直接按照我们推荐的稀释比例，进行标准操作流程。
en: If the kit is used in combination with the TotalSeq™-A Mouse Universal Cocktail, V1.0 (BioLegend, Cat. No. 199901) and the TotalSeq™-A Human Universal Cocktail, V1.0 (BioLegend, Cat. No. 399907), the antibody titration/IF preliminary experiment can be skipped, and the standard operating procedure can be performed directly using our recommended dilution ratio.

en: Take 4% PFA out of -20℃, thaw and mix well, aliquot 2 mL per tube, and store at -20℃.

zh: Wash Buffer取160 μL RI 加入3040 μL 0.1X SSC 中( 一张芯片用量）   冰上备用
en: Wash Buffer: take 160 μL of RI and add to 3040 μL of 0.1X SSC (amount for one chip); keep on ice for use.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 提前取出血清，融化后，马血清与山羊血清按 1：1 混合，用 0.22 μm 滤膜（针筒式过滤器配套一次性无菌注射器）进行过滤后分装，建议分装 200 μL/ 管（一轮的透化+ 蛋白转录组），分装后不可反复冻融超过 3 次。实验之前，−20℃取出分装血清融化， 4℃，14000g 离心 10 min，冰上备用。一张芯片用量30 μL
en: Take out the serum in advance. After thawing, mix horse serum and goat serum in a 1:1 ratio, filter the mixture using a 0.22 μm filter membrane (syringe filter with a disposable sterile syringe), then aliquot. It is recommended to aliquot 200 μL per tube (for one round of permeabilization + protein transcriptome). Do not freeze-thaw more than 3 times after aliquoting. Before the experiment, take the aliquoted serum out from -20°C to thaw, centrifuge at 4°C at 14,000g for 10 min, and keep on ice. The dosage per chip is 30 μL.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: Blocking Reagent−20℃取出融化，一张芯片用量 15μL，冰上备用−20℃
en: Blocking Reagent, take out from -20°C and thaw, usage per chip is 15 μL, keep on ice -20°C
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 剪切鲑鱼精子 DNA−20℃取出融化，一张芯片用量 30 μL，冰上备用−20℃
en: Remove sheared salmon sperm DNA from -20°C and thaw; use 30 μL per chip and keep on ice.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: RI−20℃取出，一张芯片用量 210 μL，冰上备用−20℃
en: Remove RI from -20°C; use 210 μL per chip and keep on ice.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 一抗、二抗根据说明书提示从 4℃或−20℃取出 ，4℃，14000g 离心 10 min 后置于冰上备用，一抗含有对应的同型对照抗体4℃或−20℃
en: Remove primary and secondary antibodies from 4°C or -20°C according to the manufacturer's instructions. Centrifuge at 14,000g for 10 minutes at 4°C, then place on ice for use. The primary antibody contains the corresponding isotype control antibody.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 稀释后的一抗、二抗（可选）可根据实验需求，预先进行抗体稀释   冰上备用
en: The diluted primary and secondary antibodies (optional) can be pre-diluted according to experimental needs and kept on ice for later use.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: TotalSeqTM-A Mouse Universal Cocktail, V1.0 或 TotalSeqTM-A Human Universal Cocktail, V1.0（可选）
en: TotalSeq™-A Mouse Universal Cocktail, V1.0 or TotalSeq™-A Human Universal Cocktail, V1.0 (optional)
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: a. 将冻干粉管室温平衡 5 min；b. 将冻干粉管放在空的 2 mL EP 管中，在室温下 10000g 离心 30 s；c. 加入 27.5 µL 的 1X PBS，室温孵育 5 min；d. 震荡涡旋并在室温下 10000g 离心 30 s；e. 将整个体积（27.5 µL）回溶好的抗体 Cocktail 溶液转移到新的EP 管中，4℃，14000g 离心 10 min；f. 吸取 25 uL 的上清，转移到新的 EP 管中，置于冰上备用。
en: a. Equilibrate the lyophilized powder tube at room temperature for 5 min; b. Place the lyophilized powder tube into an empty 2 mL EP tube and centrifuge at 10,000g at room temperature for 30 s; c. Add 27.5 µL of 1X PBS and incubate at room temperature for 5 min; d. Vortex and centrifuge at 10,000g at room temperature for 30 s; e. Transfer the entire volume (27.5 µL) of the reconstituted antibody Cocktail solution to a new EP tube and centrifuge at 14,000g at 4°C for 10 min; f. Aspirate 25 µL of the supernatant, transfer to a new EP tube, and place on ice for later use.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 10% Triton X-100              若无 10% Triton X-100，可将 100% Triton X-100 用 Nuclease-Free Water 稀释室温
en: 10% Triton X-100              If 10% Triton X-100 is unavailable, dilute 100% Triton X-100 with Nuclease-Free Water at room temperature

zh: 根据组织种属选择，人源组织用 Human TruStain FcX TM （Cat. No. 422301），小鼠的组织用 TruStain FcX TM PLUS （anti-mouse CD16/32） Antibody （Cat. No. 156604） ，置于冰上备用
en: Based on the choice of tissue species, use Human TruStain FcX™ (Cat. No. 422301) for human tissues, and TruStain FcX™ PLUS (anti-mouse CD16/32) Antibody (Cat. No. 156604) for mouse tissues, and keep them on ice for later use.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: Glycerol−20℃取出恢复至室温 室温
en: Take out Glycerol from -20°C and restore to room temperature, Room temperature
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: Decrosslinking      Reagent              −20℃取出恢复至室温室温
en: Take out Decrosslinking Reagent from -20°C and restore to room temperature, Room temperature
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 0.01N HCl按照HCl 浓度梯度稀释到0.01N，pH 值准确到2（确保pH 值在1.9-2.1 范围内；至少2 mL/ 样本）   室温48 hr
en: Dilute HCl to 0.01N according to the HCl concentration gradient, with pH value accurate to 2 (ensure pH value is within the 1.9-2.1 range; at least 2 mL/sample), Room temperature 48 hr
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 0.01N HCl (pH = 2.0 ) 需现配现用。对于预制的0.1N HCl 和新购买的HCl，实验前请检查pH 值。
en: 0.01N HCl (pH = 2.0) should be prepared fresh before use. For pre-made 0.1N HCl and newly purchased HCl, please check the pH value before the experiment.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 储存时间超过48 hr 将影响预期pH 值，请在配制后48 hr 内使用。
en: Storage for more than 48 hr will affect the expected pH value; please use it within 48 hr after preparation.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 10X 透化试剂储存液PR Enzyme（红盖、粉末状）短暂离心，加入 1 mL 新鲜配制的 0.01N HCl，溶解后通过移液器吹打混匀（可分装成若干份）  −20℃
en: Briefly centrifuge the 10X Permeabilization Reagent stock solution, PR Enzyme (red cap, powder form), add 1 mL of freshly prepared 0.01N HCl, dissolve and mix thoroughly by pipetting (it can be aliquoted into several portions), and store at −20°C.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 不要涡旋透化酶，可通过移液器吹打混匀。建议对配制好的10X 透化试剂储存液进行分装，避免反复冻融。
en: Do not vortex the permeabilization enzyme; mix by pipetting instead. It is recommended to aliquot the prepared 10X permeabilization reagent stock solution to avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 1X 透化试剂工作液用0.01N HCl 将10X 透化试剂储存液 15 μL 稀释到150 μL（至少150 μL/ 芯片）   冰上备用6 hr
en: To prepare the 1X permeabilization reagent working solution, dilute 15 μL of 10X permeabilization reagent stock solution to 150 μL using 0.01N HCl (at least 150 μL/chip); keep on ice and use within 6 hr.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: RT Oligo短暂离心，加入79 μL TE buffer 重悬。盖紧盖子后最大速度涡旋15 s，然后短暂离心−80℃
en: Briefly centrifuge the RT Oligo, then add 79 μL of TE buffer to resuspend. Tighten the cap, vortex at maximum speed for 15 s, briefly centrifuge, and store at -80°C.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 建议将未使用的 RT Oligo 进行分装，并保存于−80℃，避免反复冻融。
en: It is recommended to aliquot unused RT Oligo and store it at −80°C, avoiding repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: PR Rinse Buffer使用前，至少提前 5 min 取出，平衡至室温室温
en: Take out the PR Rinse Buffer at least 5 minutes before use and equilibrate to room temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 1X 透化试剂工作液在组织透化步骤前新鲜配制；用 0.01N HCl 将10X 透化试剂储存液 15 μL 稀释到 150 μL（至少 150 μL/ 芯片）冰上备用 6 hr
en: Prepare the 1X Permeabilization Reagent working solution fresh before the tissue permeabilization step; dilute 15 μL of 10X Permeabilization Reagent stock solution to 150 μL with 0.01N HCl (at least 150 μL per slide) and keep on ice for use within 6 hours.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: PR Rinse Buffer（含5% RI）
en: PR Rinse Buffer (containing 5% RI)
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 在组织透化步骤前新鲜配制；每张芯片至少准备 200 μL（190 μL PR Rinse Buffer + 10 μL RI）冰上备用
en: Prepare fresh before the tissue permeabilization step; prepare at least 200 μL per chip (190 μL PR Rinse Buffer + 10 μL RI) and keep on ice for use.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-CITE 蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书
en: 2. Operational Procedures: Stereo-CITE Protein Transcriptome Reagent Kit User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 准备仪器准备流程备注
en: Instrument Preparation | Preparation Procedure | Notes
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 冷冻切片机箱体预冷至−20℃，样本头预冷至−15℃~ −10℃温度根据实际操作过程调整
en: Pre-cool the cryostat chamber to -20°C and the specimen head to -15°C ~ -10°C. Adjust the temperatures based on the actual operation process.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 37℃用于烤片和透化（热盖42℃）
en: 37°C for slide baking and permeabilization (heated lid 42°C)
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 70℃用于解交联（热盖75℃）
en: 70°C for de-crosslinking (heated lid 75°C)
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 42℃用于反转录（热盖47℃）
en: 42°C for reverse transcription (lid 47°C)
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 55℃用于组织移除、cDNA 释放（热盖 60℃）
en: 55°C for tissue removal and cDNA release (lid 60°C)
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 检查PCR 仪是否有异常，必要时更换
en: Check the PCR instrument for any abnormalities and replace if necessary.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 金属浴( 或其他同等功能仪器)70℃用于解交联试剂预热37℃用于透化酶预热-
en: Metal bath (or other equipment with equivalent functionality): 70°C for preheating de-crosslinking reagents, 37°C for preheating permeabilization enzymes
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 荧光显微镜DAPI/FITC/ TRITC/CY5 通道可根据二抗选择不同的荧光通道
en: Fluorescence microscope with DAPI/FITC/TRITC/CY5 channels; different fluorescence channels can be selected based on the secondary antibody
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 室温用于离心 Cocktail 冻干粉提前将离心机温度调节到 4℃ 4℃用于离心血清、一抗、二抗和回溶好的抗体 Cocktail
en: Room temperature is used for centrifuging the Cocktail lyophilized powder; adjust the centrifuge temperature to 4°C in advance. 4°C is used for centrifuging serum, primary antibodies, secondary antibodies, and the reconstituted antibody Cocktail.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: a. 提前将PCR 仪温度设置到37℃，热盖温度为42℃，放置PCR 适配器平衡温度；
en: a. Pre-set the PCR machine temperature to 37°C and the thermal lid temperature to 42°C, then place the PCR adapter to equilibrate the temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: b. 冷冻切片机箱体预冷至−20℃，样本头预冷至−15℃~ −10℃（根据实际操作过程调整）；
en: b. Pre-cool the cryostat chamber to −20°C and the specimen head to −15°C ~ −10°C (adjust according to actual operation);
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: c. 提前将毛刷、刀片和镊子等置于箱体预冷；
en: c. Pre-cool brushes, blades, tweezers, etc., by placing them in the chamber in advance;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: d. 将OCT 包埋的组织块从−80℃冰箱取出，放在冷冻切片机内平衡30 min；
en: d. Take the OCT-embedded tissue block out of the -80°C freezer and place it in the cryostat to equilibrate for 30 min;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: e. 组织温度平衡过程，可参考2.5. 封闭与抗体孵育中的表格2-1 提前配制封闭液，放于冰上备用；
en: e. During the tissue temperature equilibration process, refer to Table 2-1 in 2.5. Blocking and Antibody Incubation to prepare the blocking solution in advance and keep it on ice for later use;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: f. 组织温度平衡过程，提前从4℃冰箱取出足量4% PFA 溶液于离心管内平衡至室温；
en: f. During the tissue temperature equilibration process, take out a sufficient amount of 4% PFA solution from the 4°C refrigerator into a centrifuge tube in advance and equilibrate it to room temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: g. 使用OCT 将组织块固定到样品托上；
en: g. Use OCT to fix the tissue block onto the sample holder;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: h. 将组织块修剪成合适的尺寸（切面小于0.9 cm × 0.9 cm），切去组织块周围过多的OCT，保留一部分OCT，方便转移组织；
en: h. Trim the tissue block to a suitable size (cutting surface smaller than 0.9 cm × 0.9 cm), remove excess OCT around the tissue block while retaining a portion to facilitate tissue transfer;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: i. 根据需要对组织块做最后地修剪，以确保组织切片能更好地适配芯片，随后可进行冷冻切片。
en: i. Perform final trimming of the tissue block as needed to ensure the tissue sections fit better onto the chip, followed by cryosectioning.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 样本头温度过低会导致切片出现裂纹，样本头温度过高会导致切片出现褶皱，请根据样本情况将冻头调整到合适温度。
en: If the specimen head temperature is too low, it may cause cracks in the sections; if it is too high, it may cause wrinkles. Please adjust the specimen head to an appropriate temperature based on the sample.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 42℃热盖on-
en: 42°C Heated Lid ON-
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A
Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 37℃Hold-
en: 37℃ Hold-
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-CITE 蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书
en: 2. Operational Procedure for Stereo-CITE Protein Transcriptome Reagent Kit
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: c. 清洗后用气瓶吹干芯片四周及表面，再用无尘纸吸干载玻片背面和周围多余的液体；
en: c. After cleaning, use an air duster to blow-dry the perimeter and surface of the chip, then use a lint-free wiper to absorb excess liquid from the back of the slide and the surrounding area;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: d. 如芯片表面无杂质、无明显痕迹，无任何液体残留、无波纹状纹理，即可准备贴片；
en: d. If the chip surface is free of impurities, obvious marks, residual liquid, and ripple patterns, it is ready for application;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: a. 取芯片：从真空干燥铝箔袋中取出 Stereo-seq 芯片T 载体，记录芯片背面的编号；注意不要触碰芯片正面；
en: a. Retrieving the chip: Remove the Stereo-seq chip T-carrier from the vacuum-dried aluminum foil bag and record the serial number on the back of the chip; take care not to touch the front of the chip;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: b. 将载体置于桌面上复温1 min，观察芯片表面是否有杂质，如芯片上存在杂质，使用100 μL Nuclease-Free Water 清洗2 次，可参考图a（或在含40-50 mL Nuclease-Free Water 的离心管中清洗2 次可参考图b)；
en: b. Place the carrier on a desktop to equilibrate to room temperature for 1 minute. Observe the chip surface for any impurities. If impurities are present on the chip, wash it twice with 100 μL of Nuclease-Free Water (refer to Figure a) or by washing it twice in a centrifuge tube containing 40–50 mL of Nuclease-Free Water (refer to Figure b);
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 打开后，请检查玻片盒中的所有的 Stereo-seq 芯片载体是否正确定位在插槽中，载体上的芯片是否正面朝上。芯片的正面为亮光面，正面含有用于 mRNA 捕获的探针。请勿触碰到芯片表面。
en: After opening, please check that all Stereo-seq chip carriers in the slide box are correctly positioned in their slots and that the chip on the carrier is facing upwards. The front of the chip is the glossy side and contains the probes used for mRNA capture. Please do not touch the surface of the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-CITE 蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书
en: 2. Operational Workflow: Stereo-CITE Protein Transcriptome Reagent Kit User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: e. 将组织包埋块固定至冻头上，修片；
en: e. Fix the tissue embedding block onto the cryo-chuck and perform trimming;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: f. 组织贴片有两种操作方式可选：热贴（A）和冷贴（B）
en: f. There are two optional methods for tissue section mounting: hot mounting (A) and cold mounting (B)
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 1）连续切取组织切片（根据载体上的芯片数量进行调整），用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平，然后将冷冻切片移到切片台右侧靠近边缘处，每张切片放置间隔距离大于载体宽度；
en: 1) Continuously cut tissue sections (adjusting according to the number of chips on the carrier), use a pre-cooled brush to gently manipulate the OCT surrounding the section to flatten it, then move the cryosection to the right side of the cryostat stage, near the edge, ensuring the spacing between each section is greater than the width of the carrier;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2）拿起载体的一边，使芯片正面朝下，对准切片；
en: 2) Pick up one side of the carrier, with the chip side facing down, and align it with the section;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 3）轻轻一压，肉眼可见切片已经吸附到芯片表面；
en: 3) Press gently, and the section can be visibly seen adhered to the chip surface;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 4）重复步骤2）-3）操作，直至全部组织切片吸附到芯片表面，贴片时间控制在1 min 以内；
en: 4) Repeat steps 2)-3) until all tissue sections are adhered to the chip surface, controlling the mounting time to within 1 min;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 5）将芯片正面朝上，快速将载体置于提前平衡温度的PCR 适配器上，37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 仪热盖。
en: 5) Place the chip face up, quickly place the carrier onto the pre-equilibrated PCR adapter, and incubate at 37°C for 5 min, without covering the PCR thermal lid.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 1)  将玻片正面朝上置于切片机中，预冷1-6 min；
en: 1) Place the slide in the cryostat with the front side facing up, and pre-cool for 1-6 min;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2）进行冷冻切片，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平。用镊子和毛刷将切片小心覆盖在芯片正中央并铺平，注意毛刷不要触碰到组织。尽量一次贴片成功，确保组织切片完整，无褶皱；
en: 2) Perform cryosectioning, then use a pre-cooled brush to gently adjust the OCT around the section to flatten it. Carefully place and flatten the section in the center of the chip using tweezers and a brush, ensuring the brush does not touch the tissue. Try to mount it successfully in one attempt, ensuring the tissue section is intact and free of folds;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 3）立即拿起芯片载体，用指腹放在载体背面加温几秒钟，直至切片贴合；
en: 3) Immediately pick up the chip carrier and warm the back of it with the ball of your finger for a few seconds until the section adheres;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 4）重复上述操作，直至所有切片贴片完成，建议组织切片贴片控制在5 min 内；
en: 4) Repeat the above steps until all sections have been mounted; it is recommended that the mounting of tissue sections be completed within 5 minutes;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 预冷时间不可过长，以免玻片表面产生水雾；预冷时间不可太短，以免玻片无法达到预冷温度。
en: The pre-cooling time should not be too long to avoid condensation on the slide surface; the pre-cooling time should not be too short to prevent the slide from failing to reach the pre-cooling temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 5）快速将载体置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Quickly place the carrier onto the PCR adapter and incubate at 37°C for 5 min; there is no need to close the PCR thermal lid.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 进行冷贴时需控制好每张切片贴片时间，间隔时间太大，组织贴片会皱缩。
en: When performing cold mounting, control the mounting time for each section; if the interval is too long, the tissue section will wrinkle.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: （可选暂停点）将孵育好的芯片载体放于玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管，用干冰快速转移到−80℃冰箱，最长可于−80℃保存一个月。
en: (Optional stopping point) Place the incubated chip carrier into a slide box or a 50 mL centrifuge tube, transfer it quickly to a -80°C freezer using dry ice, and it can be stored at -80°C for up to one month.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 继续实验时，使用干冰将玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管转移，取出贴有组织的芯片载体，快速置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min。
en: When continuing the experiment, transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube using dry ice, remove the tissue-attached chip carrier, and quickly place it onto the PCR adapter to incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-CITE 蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书
en: 2. Operational Procedure for Stereo-CITE Proteomic Transcriptomic Reagent Kit
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: a. 参考《Stereo-seq 芯片载体及配件使用说明书》第二章将垫圈与夹具组合成载具；
en: a. Refer to Chapter 2 of the "Stereo-seq Chip Carrier and Accessories User Manual" to assemble the gasket and fixture into a carrier;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: b. 将上一步孵育完成的芯片载体固定于载具上，组合成手持载具，确保夹具8 个卡扣扣紧并且载体两侧贴紧夹具两侧 ；
en: b. Secure the chip carrier incubated in the previous step onto the carrier to assemble the handheld carrier, ensuring that the 8 buckles of the fixture are fastened and that both sides of the carrier are tightly attached to both sides of the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: c. 将载具置于通风橱内操作，加入4% PFA 溶液，用量为400 μL/ 芯片，撕掉封板膜上的白膜，用透明的封板膜封口，固定10 min；
en: c. Place the carrier in a fume hood, add 400 μL/chip of 4% PFA solution, remove the white film from the sealing film, seal with a transparent sealing film, and fix for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: d. 固定完成后，撕开封板膜，微微倾斜手持载具，倾斜角度小于20°，用移液器在芯片一角吸弃4% PFA 溶液，注意保持芯片组织湿润；
en: d. After fixation is complete, remove the sealing film, hold the carrier and tilt it slightly at an angle of less than 20°, use a pipette to aspirate and discard the 4% PFA solution from one corner of the chip, taking care to keep the chip tissue moist;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: e. 立即加入Wash Buffer，用量为400 μL/ 芯片，室温孵育1 min；
en: e. Immediately add 400 μL/chip of Wash Buffer, and incubate at room temperature for 1 min;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: f. 微微倾斜手持载具，倾斜角度小于20°，用移液器在芯片一角吸弃Wash Buffer 溶液，保持芯片组织湿润；
en: f. Slightly tilt the handheld carrier at an angle of less than 20°, use a pipette to aspirate and discard the Wash Buffer solution from one corner of the chip, keeping the chip tissue moist;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: g. 重复步骤e.-f. 一次，共计清洗2 次。
en: g. Repeat steps e.-f. once, for a total of 2 washes.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: a. 此时可将载具转移至通风橱外实验桌操作，立即将已配制好的封闭液滴加到组织表面，用量为150 μL/ 芯片，室温孵育20 min；
en: a. At this point, the carrier can be transferred to the laboratory bench outside the fume hood for operation; immediately add the prepared blocking solution dropwise to the tissue surface, with a volume of 150 μL/chip, and incubate at room temperature for 20 min;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 避免载具接触芯片正面。
en: Avoid contact between the carrier and the front side of the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 换液过程中避免组织干燥，避免移液器和枪头碰触到组织和芯片。
en: Avoid tissue desiccation during liquid exchange, and prevent the pipette and pipette tip from touching the tissue and the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: * FcR Blocking Reagent 为封闭细胞膜表面FC 受体，可跟据实验组织的种属选择购买。例如组织为人源性组织，则选择Human TruStain FcXTM（Biolegend, Cat. No. 422301），小鼠的组织则选择TruStain FcXTM PLUS （anti-mouse CD16/32） Antibody （Biolegend, Cat. No.156604）。
en: * FcR Blocking Reagent is used to block Fc receptors on the cell membrane surface and can be purchased based on the species of the experimental tissue. For example, if the tissue is of human origin, choose Human TruStain FcXTM (Biolegend, Cat. No. 422301); for mouse tissue, choose TruStain FcXTM PLUS (anti-mouse CD16/32) Antibody (Biolegend, Cat. No. 156604).
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 1X 封闭液的量足够用于单张组织切片的组织封闭和一抗孵育液配制。
en: The volume of 1X Blocking Buffer is sufficient for tissue blocking of a single tissue section and for the preparation of the primary antibody incubation solution.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: b. 封闭等待期间，根据试剂情况配制一抗孵育液。若自由组合TotalSeqTM-A 抗体，请根据实际检测蛋白数量 n，参考2.5. 封闭与抗体孵育中的表格2-2配制一抗孵育液，涡旋混匀后瞬时离心，放于冰盒上备用。若搭配TotalSeqTM-A Mouse Universal Cocktail, V1.0 （Biolegend, Cat. No. 199901） 和TotalSeqTM-A Human Universal Cocktail, V1.0 （Biolegend, Cat. No. 399907）使用，请参考2.5. 封闭与抗体孵育中的表格2-3 配制一抗孵育液。
en: b. During the blocking incubation period, prepare the primary antibody incubation solution according to the reagents used. If using a custom combination of TotalSeq™-A antibodies, prepare the primary antibody incubation solution based on the actual number of proteins to be detected (n) by referring to Table 2-2 in "2.5. Blocking and Antibody Incubation," then vortex to mix, centrifuge briefly, and place on ice for later use. If using in combination with TotalSeq™-A Mouse Universal Cocktail, V1.0 (BioLegend, Cat. No. 199901) and TotalSeq™-A Human Universal Cocktail, V1.0 (BioLegend, Cat. No. 399907), please refer to Table 2-3 in "2.5. Blocking and Antibody Incubation" to prepare the primary antibody incubation solution.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 一抗1-n 需含有对应的同型对照抗体，务必根据实验前准备，进行TotalSeqTM-A 抗体的离心；吸取TotalSeqTM-A 抗体时，尽量避免枪头直接从管底部吸取。
en: Primary antibodies 1-n must include the corresponding isotype control antibodies. Be sure to perform centrifugation of the TotalSeq™-A antibodies according to the pre-experiment preparation; when pipetting the TotalSeq™-A antibodies, try to avoid taking them directly from the bottom of the tube with the pipette tip.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: c. 用移液器在芯片一角吸弃封闭液，保持芯片组织湿润，立即从非组织区域缓慢加入一抗体孵育液，用量为150 μL/ 芯片，室温孵育45 min；
en: c. Aspirate and discard the blocking buffer from one corner of the chip using a pipette, ensuring the tissue on the chip remains moist. Immediately and slowly add 150 μL of primary antibody incubation buffer per chip, starting from the non-tissue area. Incubate at room temperature for 45 minutes;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: d. 一抗孵育等待期间，参考2.5. 封闭与抗体孵育中的表格2-4 配制二抗孵育液，涡旋混匀后瞬时离心，放于冰盒上避光备用；
en: d. While waiting for the primary antibody incubation, prepare the secondary antibody incubation buffer according to Table 2-4 in "2.5. Blocking and Antibody Incubation". Vortex to mix, centrifuge briefly, and keep on ice, protected from light, for later use;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: e. 用移液器在芯片一角吸弃一抗孵育液，保持芯片组织湿润；
en: e. Using a pipette, aspirate the primary antibody incubation solution from one corner of the chip, keeping the chip tissue moist;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: f. 往芯片加入 Wash Buffer，用量为200 μL/ 芯片，室温孵育1 min；
en: f. Add Wash Buffer to the chip at a volume of 200 μL/chip and incubate at room temperature for 1 min;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: g. 微微倾斜手持载具，倾斜角度小于20°，用移液器在芯片一角吸弃Wash Buffer，保持芯片组织湿润；
en: g. Slightly tilt the handheld carrier at an angle of less than 20°, and use a pipette to aspirate the Wash Buffer from one corner of the chip, keeping the chip tissue moist;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: h. 重复步骤f.-g. 一次，总共清洗2 次；
en: h. Repeat steps f.-g. once, for a total of 2 washes.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: i. 从非组织区域缓慢滴加二抗孵育液，用量为150 μL/ 芯片，室温避光孵育15 min。
en: i. Slowly add 150 μL/chip of secondary antibody incubation solution from the non-tissue area, and incubate at room temperature for 15 min, protected from light.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 换液过程中严格避免组织干燥，若组织干燥易产生非特异性信号。建议一个孔位一个孔位进行操作。
en: Strictly avoid tissue drying during the liquid exchange process, as tissue drying can easily generate non-specific signals. It is recommended to perform the operation one well at a time.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 换液过程注意芯片不可干燥，若组织干燥易产生非特异性信号。
en: During the buffer exchange process, ensure that the chip does not dry out, as tissue desiccation can easily lead to non-specific signals.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

It is recommended to use the Alexa FluorTM Plus series fluorescent secondary antibodies from Thermo Fisher Scientific, which can be prepared at a 1:500 dilution. If using fluorescent secondary antibodies from other companies, please determine the appropriate ratio based on your own experience.

en: h. Slowly add Wash Buffer for washing, with a volume of 200 μL / chip, and incubate for 1 min;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: i. 倾斜载体，用移液器从芯片一角吸弃Wash Buffer，尽量减少液体残留；
en: i. Tilt the carrier, and use a pipette to aspirate Wash Buffer from a corner of the chip, minimizing residual liquid;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: j. 重复清洗步骤h.-i. 一次；
en: j. Repeat the washing steps h.-i. once;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: k. 吸弃Wash Buffer 后，参考《Stereo-seq 芯片载体及配件使用说明书》第三章将载体从手持载具上拆卸下来，将拆卸下来的夹具放置在实验台上备用；
en: k. After aspirating the Wash Buffer, refer to Chapter 3 of the *Stereo-seq Chip Carrier and Accessories User Manual* to detach the carrier from the handheld fixture, and place the detached fixture on the lab bench for later use;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 换液过程注意芯片不可干燥，若组织干燥易产生非特异性信号。
en: Ensure the chip does not dry out during the liquid exchange process; if the tissue dries, it is prone to producing non-specific signals.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 拆卸时用手托住载体背面，避免载具接触芯片正面 。
en: Support the back of the carrier with your hand during detachment to avoid contact between the fixture and the front side of the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-CITE 蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书
en: 2. Workflow: Stereo-CITE Protein Transcriptome Reagent Kit User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: l. 将载体转移至无尘纸上，一只手固定载体，另一只手拿空气罐，在出气口距离芯片一角 2-3 cm 位置，以大概30°倾角缓慢吹气。从芯片角落开始顺序推进，吹干芯片表面液体，勿使气流过猛；
en: 1. Transfer the carrier to a lint-free wipe. Secure the carrier with one hand, and hold the air duster with the other hand. Position the air nozzle 2-3 cm away from a corner of the chip, and slowly blow air at an angle of approximately 30°. Proceed sequentially starting from the corner of the chip to dry the liquid on the chip surface; ensure the airflow is not too strong;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: （可选操作）使用载玻片离心机（微型玻片离心机LX-700）离心10 s 甩干芯片上液体；
en: (Optional) Use a slide centrifuge (mini slide centrifuge LX-700) to centrifuge for 10 s to spin dry the liquid on the chip;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: m. 用移液器缓慢吸取5 μL Glycerol 甘油滴加到组织中央，避免产生气泡；
en: m. Use a pipette to slowly draw 5 μL of Glycerol and add it dropwise to the center of the tissue, avoiding the formation of air bubbles;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: n. 用镊子夹取盖玻片或24 孔板圆形细胞爬片的一端，小心将盖玻片或爬片的另一端放在芯片边上，然后逐渐将盖玻片或爬片放低到芯片上，直至完全覆盖芯片；待甘油浸润整张芯片后，立即安排拍照，避免荧光淬灭。
en: n. Use forceps to grasp one end of a coverslip or a 24-well plate circular cell coverslip, carefully place the other end of the coverslip against the edge of the chip, then gradually lower the coverslip onto the chip until it completely covers the chip; once the glycerol has infiltrated the entire chip, proceed with imaging immediately to avoid fluorescence quenching.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 请保证盖玻片使用前干净无灰尘，可使用酒精擦拭盖玻片表面或者使用空气罐吹干净。
en: Please ensure the coverslip is clean and free of dust before use. You can wipe the surface of the coverslip with alcohol or blow it clean using a compressed air can.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-CITE 蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书
en: 2. Operating Procedure: Stereo-CITE Proteotranscriptome Reagent Kit User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 本部分以Motic 显微镜为例，进行拍照操作的描述。另外，本试剂套装也兼容其它品牌的显微镜，关于显微镜的具体要求，请参考《STOmics 显微镜评估手册》。其它显微镜操作可能不同，但需要保证DAPI 通道的Track 线清晰和各个荧光通道所获得的图像之间无串色。
en: This section describes the imaging procedure using a Motic microscope as an example. Additionally, this reagent kit is compatible with microscopes from other brands; for specific microscope requirements, please refer to the "STOmics Microscope Evaluation Manual". Procedures for other microscopes may differ, but it is essential to ensure that the track lines in the DAPI channel are clear and that there is no crosstalk between images acquired from different fluorescence channels.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 拍照时，需要使用具有拼接功能的荧光显微镜拍摄荧光图像，推荐荧光配置：
en: For imaging, a fluorescence microscope with stitching functionality is required to capture fluorescence images. Recommended fluorescence configuration:
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: • 光源波长范围：380-680 nm
en: • Light source wavelength range: 380-680 nm
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: • 黑白相机（≥ 12 bit）
en: • Monochrome camera (≥ 12-bit)
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: • DAPI filter cube（参考: Excitation 375/28 nm, Emission 460/50 nm）
en: • DAPI filter cube (Ref.: Excitation 375/28 nm, Emission 460/50 nm)
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: • FITC filter cube（参考：Excitation 480/30 nm, Emission 525/50 nm）
en: • FITC filter cube (Ref.: Excitation 480/30 nm, Emission 525/50 nm)
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: • TRITC filter cube（参考：Excitation 545/25 nm, Emission 605/70 nm）
en: • TRITC filter cube (Ref: Excitation 545/25 nm, Emission 605/70 nm)
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: • CY5 filter cube（参考：Excitation 620/50 nm, Emission 690/50 nm）
en: • Cy5 filter cube (Ref: Excitation 620/50 nm, Emission 690/50 nm)
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: • 最大像元尺寸：5 μm/pixel
en: • Maximum pixel size: 5 μm/pixel
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: • 曝光时间：1 ms~2 s（取决于使用抗体的特性）
en: • Exposure time: 1 ms ~ 2 s (depending on the characteristics of the antibody used)
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: a. 首先进行DAPI 染色的拍照，在连接荧光显微镜的电脑中新建文件夹，以芯片号（例：Y00035N1）命名，也可适当注明其他相关信息；
en: a. First, take photos of the DAPI staining. Create a new folder on the computer connected to the fluorescence microscope, named after the chip number (e.g., Y00035N1); other relevant information can also be noted appropriately;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: b. 在载物台上滴加1-2 μL 水（~2μL/ 滴），可避免载体在扫描过程中发生位移，然后小心地将芯片载体放置在载物台的水上；
en: b. Add 1-2 μL of water (~2 μL/drop) to the stage to prevent the carrier from shifting during the scanning process, then carefully place the chip carrier onto the water on the stage;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 文件夹名称只使用字母、数字、下划线，禁止使用空格等特殊字符。
en: Folder names must only contain letters, numbers, and underscores; spaces and other special characters are prohibited.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: c．取下遮光罩，选择落射荧光扫描模式，选择4 倍镜、DAPI 通道并找到目标区域。 设置亮度与增益。具体参数取决于不同的显微镜型号。在组织能清晰成像的前提下，需选择更低的光强以避免荧光淬灭；
en: c. Remove the light shield, select epi-fluorescence scanning mode, choose the 4x objective and DAPI channel, and locate the target area. Set the brightness and gain. Specific parameters depend on the microscope model. Provided that the tissue is clearly imaged, a lower light intensity should be selected to avoid fluorescence quenching;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-CITE 蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书
en: 2. Operational Workflow for the Stereo-CITE Protein Transcriptome Reagent Kit User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: d. 用4 倍镜扫描完成后，切换到10 倍镜，扫描整张芯片；如图二所示，以小鼠半脑组织的DAPI 通道扫描图像为例，中间图片红框内为选中的目标组织区域，蓝色小方框为添加的对焦点；左图为组织外选取的一个对焦点视野窗口截图，应确保Track 线清晰且分明；右图为组织内选取的一个对焦点视野窗口截图，应确保组织轮廓清晰；
en: d. After scanning with the 4x objective lens, switch to the 10x objective lens and scan the entire chip. As shown in Figure 2, taking the DAPI channel scanned image of mouse hemibrain tissue as an example, the area inside the red box in the middle image is the selected target tissue region, and the small blue square boxes are the added focus points. The left image is a screenshot of the field of view for a focus point selected outside the tissue, where the track lines should be clear and distinct. The right image is a screenshot of the field of view for a focus point selected inside the tissue, where the tissue outline should be clear.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 图二. 小鼠半脑DAPI 染色图
en: Figure 2. DAPI staining image of mouse hemibrain
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: e. 待成像完成后，保存图像并保持芯片不动；  f. 接下来进行IF 的图像拍摄，在连接荧光显微镜的电脑中新建文件夹， 以 芯 片 号 _IF 格 式 命 名 （例：Y00035N1_IF）并保存，根据二抗偶联的荧光染料选择合适的荧光通道（FITC 通道、TRITC 通道或CY5 通道）进行下一步IF 的拍照。保持芯片不动，不重新扫描地图，不重新添加对焦点，不改变红框选中组织区域，直接切换所选的荧光通道，随后可调节曝光直至组织内染色图像清晰，10 倍镜下扫描IF 图片；
en: e. After imaging is complete, save the images and keep the chip stationary; f. Next, proceed with IF image capture. Create a new folder on the computer connected to the fluorescence microscope, named in the format "ChipID_IF" (e.g., Y00035N1_IF), and save to it. Select the appropriate fluorescence channel (FITC channel, TRITC channel, or CY5 channel) based on the fluorescent dye conjugated to the secondary antibody for the subsequent IF imaging. Keep the chip stationary, do not rescan the map, do not re-add focus points, and do not change the red-boxed selected tissue area. Directly switch to the selected fluorescence channel, then adjust the exposure until the stained image within the tissue is clear, and scan the IF image under a 10x objective lens;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: g. 可根据此步荧光染色结果，来判断TotalSeqTM-A 一抗是否成功结合。判断标准与所加入的抗体种类有关，所获得的图像应与IF 染色的先验知识相符。比如，以图三为例，由于加入了很多种一抗，胸腺组织基本全部都有信号（左图），具体放大来看（右图），因为投入的都是识别细胞膜的一抗，放大后能够清晰的看到细胞膜染色。证明抗体的结合没有问题；
en: g. The results of the fluorescence staining in this step can be used to determine whether the TotalSeqTM-A primary antibody has successfully bound. The judgment criteria depend on the types of antibodies added, and the obtained images should be consistent with prior knowledge of IF staining. For instance, in Figure 3, since many types of primary antibodies were added, almost the entire thymus tissue shows signal (left image). Upon specific magnification (right image), because the added primary antibodies were all those recognizing the cell membrane, clear cell membrane staining is visible, which confirms successful antibody binding;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 图三. 小鼠胸腺组织IF 染色情况示例
en: Figure 3. Example of IF staining in mouse thymus tissue
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 二抗的染色情况可以用来判断一抗是否成功结合，不成功不建议继续后续实验。
en: The staining results of the secondary antibody can be used to assess whether the primary antibody has successfully bound; if it has not, it is not recommended to proceed with further experiments.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 文件夹名称只使用字母、数字、下划线，禁止使用空格等特殊字符。
en: Use only letters, numbers, and underscores for folder names; spaces and other special characters are prohibited.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-CITE 蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书
en: 2. Operation Workflow: Stereo-CITE Protein Transcriptome Reagent Kit Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: h. 保存整个文件夹（拼接大图和小图文件夹）；
en: h. Save the entire folder (stitched large image and small image folders);
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: i. 打开 ImageStudio 软件内的图像 QC 模块。上传核染色图（DAPI），然后参考软件内置的ImageStudio 用户手册来进行图像QC；
en: i. Open the Image QC module within the ImageStudio software. Upload the nuclear staining image (DAPI), and then refer to the built-in ImageStudio User Manual to perform image QC;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: j. 拍照后，从显微镜卸下载体芯片，暂时保持封片，进行下一步的准备。
en: j. After imaging, unload the chip carrier from the microscope, temporarily maintain the mounting, and proceed to the next preparation step.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 从封片到拍照结束控制在1 hr 内完成，并在拍照过程中请勿将贴有组织的芯片长时间照射荧光，非拍照时间关闭激光，避免长时间照射。
en: The time from mounting to the completion of imaging must be controlled within 1 hour. During imaging, do not expose the tissue-attached chip to fluorescence for an extended period; turn off the laser when not imaging to avoid prolonged exposure.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 获得的核染色图（DAPI）需要通过QC 才能开展进一步的图像分析 (register)。
en: The acquired nuclear staining images (DAPI) must pass QC before further image analysis (registration) can be performed.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 如果QC 失败，请仔细检查图像清晰度，调整拍照方法进行二次拍照以确保可以获得清晰的组织及Track 线图像。若二次拍照QC 仍失败，继续实验。实验结束可联系FAS 帮助排查问题。
en: If QC fails, please carefully check the image clarity, adjust the imaging method, and retake images to ensure clear images of the tissue and Track lines can be obtained. If QC still fails after the second attempt, continue with the experiment. After the experiment, you may contact your FAS for assistance in troubleshooting.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-CITE 蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书
en: 2. Operational Procedure, Stereo-CITE Protein Transcriptome Reagent Kit Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: c. Decrosslinking Reagent 使用前置于金属浴或其他同等功能仪器中70℃孵育10 min（最长不超过30 min）；
en: c. Before use, incubate the Decrosslinking Reagent in a metal bath or other equivalent equipment at 70°C for 10 min (do not exceed 30 min);
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: d. 用镊子将盖玻片轻轻推至载体边缘，夹住盖玻片一角，轻轻地平行移动盖玻片，直到芯片与盖玻片完全分离；
en: d. Use tweezers to gently push the coverslip to the edge of the carrier, grip one corner of the coverslip, and gently move the coverslip in parallel until the chip is completely separated from the coverslip;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: a. 根据【实验前准备】，提前解冻 Decrosslinking Reagent 并恢复到室温；
en: a. According to [Pre-experimental preparation], thaw the Decrosslinking Reagent in advance and bring it to room temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: b. 提前将 PCR 仪的温度设置到 70℃，热盖温度为 75℃，放置 PCR 适配器平衡温度；
en: b. Set the PCR instrument temperature to 70°C and the heated lid temperature to 75°C in advance, and place the PCR adapter to equilibrate the temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 75℃热盖  on-
en: 75°C Lid on-
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

en: 70°C 15 min
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 70℃Hold-
en: 70°C Hold-
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: Decrosslinking Reagent 使用多少预热多少，请勿反复预热。
en: Preheat only the amount of Decrosslinking Reagent required; do not preheat repeatedly.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: e. 用无尘纸擦去载体背面及芯片四周的液体，确保无液体残留；
en: e. Use a lint-free wipe to wipe away any liquid from the back of the carrier and around the chip, ensuring no liquid residue remains;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: f. 更换新垫圈，按照《Stereo-seq 芯片载体及配件使用说明书》第二章组合成手持载具，确保夹具8 个卡扣扣紧并且载体两侧贴紧夹具两侧 ；
en: f. Replace with a new gasket and assemble into a handheld carrier following Chapter 2 of the "Stereo-seq Chip Carrier and Accessories User Manual," ensuring the 8 latches of the fixture are securely fastened and both sides of the carrier are firmly against the sides of the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: g. 组合载具后，往芯片加入Wash Buffer，用量为400 μL/ 芯片，室温孵育1 min；
en: g. After the carrier is assembled, add 400 μL of Wash Buffer to the chip and incubate at room temperature for 1 min;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: h. 微微倾斜手持载具，倾斜角度小于20°，用移液器在芯片一角吸弃Wash Buffer，保持芯片组织湿润；
en: h. Tilt the handheld carrier slightly at an angle of less than 20°, and aspirate the Wash Buffer from one corner of the chip using a pipette, ensuring the tissue on the chip remains moist;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: i. 重复清洗步骤g.-h. 一次；
en: i. Repeat the washing steps g.-h. once;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: j. 清洗结束后，往带芯片的孔内加入Decrosslinking Reagent，用量为400 μL/ 芯片，用封板膜封口，放置于PCR 仪（70℃）的PCR 适配器上，关闭PCR 仪模块盖子，70℃解交联15 min；
en: j. After washing, add 400 μL of Decrosslinking Reagent per chip to the wells containing the chips, seal with a plate sealing film, place on the PCR adapter of a PCR instrument set to 70°C, close the module lid, and incubate at 70°C for 15 min for decrosslinking;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

en: This reagent kit recommends using VAHTS DNA Clean Beads (Vazyme, Cat. No. N411-02) or AMPure® XP (Agencourt, Cat. No. A63882) for magnetic bead purification. If using magnetic beads from other brands, the purification conditions need to be re-optimized.

en: • The amount of magnetic beads used directly affects the distribution of the purified DNA fragments. A higher amount of magnetic beads results in a smaller lower length limit for the purified DNA fragments.

en: • After mixing the sample and magnetic beads thoroughly, place them on a magnetic stand for separation. Please aspirate the supernatant only after the solution has become completely clear, which typically takes 2-3 minutes. However, due to differences in magnetic stand strength, the recommended separation time may sometimes need to be extended; ensure the liquid is completely clear before proceeding.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: •	 在分离磁珠与液体时，注意吸头不可碰到磁珠，最后可余留2-3 μL 液体，以避免吸到磁珠。若不慎吸到磁珠，可将磁珠与液体全部打回管内，再次分离后再吸取上清。
en: • When separating magnetic beads from the liquid, ensure that the pipette tip does not touch the magnetic beads. It is advisable to leave 2-3 μL of liquid behind to avoid aspirating the beads. If magnetic beads are accidentally aspirated, dispense the beads and liquid back into the tube, perform the separation again, and then aspirate the supernatant.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: •	 磁珠乙醇漂洗应使用新鲜配制并平衡至室温的80% 乙醇。漂洗过程中离心管应始终置于磁力架上，移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠。
en: • Magnetic bead ethanol washing should be performed using freshly prepared 80% ethanol that has been equilibrated to room temperature. During the washing process, the centrifuge tube should always remain on the magnetic stand. The pipette tip should be operated on the tube wall away from the magnetic stand; do not pipette up and down or agitate the magnetic beads.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: •	 第二次乙醇漂洗应尽量吸干管底液体。若有少量液体残留在管壁，可将离心管瞬时离心，在磁力架上分离后，用小量程的移液器把管底液体吸干。
en: • For the second ethanol wash, aspirate as much liquid as possible from the bottom of the tube. If a small amount of liquid remains on the tube wall, briefly centrifuge the tube, place it on a magnetic rack to separate, and then use a low-volume pipette to aspirate the liquid from the bottom of the tube.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-CITE 蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书
en: 2. Operation Procedure for Stereo-CITE Protein Transcriptome Reagent Kit
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: •	 两次乙醇漂洗后，应在室温下充分干燥磁珠。干燥不充分（磁珠表面反光）容易造成乙醇残留，影响后续反应，过度干燥（磁珠开裂）会降低回收得率。通常情况下，室温干燥需要5-10 min，但由于室内温度和湿度的差异，干燥时间可能会不同，应随时观察。直至磁珠表面无反光，即可用TE Buffer 或 Nuclease-Free Water 进行产物洗脱。
en: After two ethanol washes, the magnetic beads should be dried thoroughly at room temperature. Insufficient drying (magnetic beads surface appearing reflective) may lead to ethanol residue, affecting subsequent reactions; excessive drying (magnetic beads cracking) will reduce the recovery yield. Typically, drying at room temperature takes 5-10 minutes, but drying time may vary due to differences in room temperature and humidity; therefore, monitor constantly. Once the surface of the magnetic beads is no longer reflective, the product can be eluted using TE Buffer or Nuclease-Free Water.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: •	 洗脱后吸取上清时，切忌触碰磁珠，若吸到磁珠可能会影响后续的纯化反应。所以，最终吸取的上清可比用于洗脱的TE Buffer 或 Nuclease-Free Water 的体积少~2 μL。
en: When aspirating the supernatant after elution, do not touch the magnetic beads. Aspirating magnetic beads may affect subsequent purification reactions. Therefore, the final volume of supernatant aspirated can be ~2 μL less than the volume of TE Buffer or Nuclease-Free Water used for elution.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: •	 在1.5 mL 磁力架上开关管盖应避免剧烈震动导致磁珠或液体弹出，建议用手指固定住1.5 mL 离心管中下段，然后开盖。
en: When opening or closing the tube lid on the 1.5 mL magnetic stand, avoid violent vibrations that could cause the magnetic beads or liquid to pop out. It is recommended to secure the middle-lower part of the 1.5 mL centrifuge tube with your fingers, then open the lid.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-CITE 蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书

zh: a. cDNA 回收液如果观察到有白色沉淀析出，可放于 55℃溶解，恢复至室温后进行纯化；提前 30 min 取出磁珠，平衡至室温；提前准备新鲜配制并平衡至室温的 80% 乙醇；
en: a. If white precipitate is observed in the cDNA recovery solution, it can be dissolved at 55°C and purified after restoring to room temperature; take out the magnetic beads 30 minutes in advance and equilibrate to room temperature; prepare fresh 80% ethanol and equilibrate it to room temperature in advance.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: b.  转录组1.0X 磁珠cDNA 纯化步骤;
en: b. Transcriptome 1.0X magnetic bead cDNA purification steps;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 1）将上一步回收液（450-490 μL）与室温平衡好的磁珠按照1 : 1 混合加入1.5 mL 离心管内，震荡混匀，室温孵育10 min；
en: 1) Mix the recovery solution from the previous step (450-490 μL) with the room temperature-equilibrated magnetic beads at a 1:1 ratio, add to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube, vortex to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2）瞬时离心后，将离心管放在磁力架上静置3 min；
en: 2) After pulse centrifugation, place the centrifuge tube on a magnetic rack and let it stand for 3 min;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 3）待液体澄清后，用移液器小心转移上清至另一 2.0 mL 离心管内。此部分包含 ADT 产物，可暂时存于室温，参考步骤 2.16 进行 ADT 产物纯化；
en: 3) Once the liquid is clear, carefully transfer the supernatant to another 2.0 mL centrifuge tube using a pipette. This fraction contains the ADT products and can be temporarily stored at room temperature; refer to step 2.16 for ADT product purification;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 4）将离心管保持在磁力架上，加入1 mL 80% 乙醇（使用新鲜配制并平衡至室温的80% 乙醇），旋转磁力架上的离心管，待磁珠全部吸附到靠磁力架一侧的管壁，再次旋离心管，让磁珠重新吸附到另一侧来漂洗磁珠。静置30 s，小心吸取并丢弃上清;
en: 4) Keeping the centrifuge tube on the magnetic rack, add 1 mL of 80% ethanol (using freshly prepared 80% ethanol equilibrated to room temperature). Rotate the centrifuge tube on the magnetic rack until all magnetic beads are adsorbed to the side wall against the rack, then rotate the tube again to re-adsorb the magnetic beads to the other side to wash them. Let stand for 30 s, then carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 5）重复步骤4）一次；
en: 5) Repeat step 4 once;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 6）将1.5 mL 离心管保持在磁力架上，室温风干5-8 min，直至磁珠表面无反光、无开裂；
en: 6) Keep the 1.5 mL centrifuge tube on the magnetic rack, air-dry at room temperature for 5-8 min, until the surface of the magnetic beads is no longer reflective and shows no cracks;

zh: 7）先加22 μL Nuclease-Free Water 回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置 3-5 min，直至液体变澄清；
en: 7) Add 22 μL Nuclease-Free Water to resuspend, vortex to mix, let stand at room temperature for 5 min, pulse centrifuge, and keep on the magnetic rack for 3-5 min until the liquid becomes clear;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 8）将上清（~21 μL cDNA）转移至新的0.2 mL PCR 管中；
en: 8) Transfer the supernatant (~21 μL cDNA) to a new 0.2 mL PCR tube;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 9）再将 22 μL Nuclease-Free Water 加入步骤7）的磁珠中二次回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置 5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置 3-5 min，直至液体变澄清；
en: 9) Add 22 μL of Nuclease-Free Water to the magnetic beads from step 7) for a second elution, mix by vortexing, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, centrifuge briefly, and place on a magnetic rack for 3-5 min until the liquid becomes clear;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 10）将上清（~21 μL cDNA）转移至步骤8）的 PCR 管中，合并总体积~42 μL。
en: 10) Transfer the supernatant (~21 μL cDNA) to the PCR tube from step 8) to achieve a combined total volume of ~42 μL.
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠（如果管盖上有泡沫，建议用 80% 乙醇清洗干净）。
en: The pipette tip should be operated against the tube wall away from the magnetic stand; do not pipette up and down or disturb the magnetic beads (if there is foam on the tube cap, it is recommended to clean it with 80% ethanol).

zh: c.  如果上述回收样品不足42 μL，用Nuclease-Free Water 补足。

zh: 1）将cDNA PCR 产物（100 μL）与室温平衡好的磁珠按照1 : 1 混合，震荡混匀，室温孵育10 min；
en: 1) Mix the cDNA PCR products (100 μL) with magnetic beads equilibrated to room temperature at a 1:1 ratio, vortex to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min;

zh: 3）将离心管保持在磁力架上，加入200 μL 80% 乙醇漂洗（新鲜配制并平衡至室温的80% 乙醇）。通过旋转磁力架上的离心管来漂洗磁珠。静置30 s，小心吸取并丢弃上清。移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠；
en: 3) Keep the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand and add 200 μL of 80% ethanol to wash (freshly prepared and equilibrated to room temperature 80% ethanol). Wash the magnetic beads by rotating the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand. Let it stand for 30 s, then carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant. The pipette tip should be operated on the tube wall away from the magnetic stand; do not pipette up and down or disturb the magnetic beads;

zh: 6）加42 μL 的TE Buffer 回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置3-5 min，待液体澄清后将上清（~40 μL）转移到新的1.5 mL离心管中。

zh: 1) 在 4.14 步骤 2.0 mL 离心管内上清中，加入额外的 500 µL 室温平衡好的磁珠混合，震荡混匀，室温孵育 10 min；
en: 1) To the supernatant in the 2.0 mL centrifuge tube from step 4.14, add an additional 500 µL of magnetic bead mix equilibrated to room temperature, vortex to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 2) 瞬时离心后，将离心管放在磁力架上静置 5 min；
en: 2) After brief centrifugation, place the centrifuge tube on a magnetic stand and let it stand for 5 min;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 3) 待液体澄清后，用移液器小心去除上清；
en: 3) After the liquid becomes clear, carefully remove the supernatant with a pipette;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 4) 将 2.0 mL 离心管保持在磁力架上，加入 1.5 mL 80% 乙醇（使用新鲜配制并平衡至室温的 80% 乙醇），旋转磁力架上的离心管，待磁珠全部吸附到靠磁力架一侧的管壁，再次旋转离心管，让磁珠重新吸附到另一侧来漂洗磁珠。静置 30 s，小心吸取并丢弃上清；
en: 4) Keep the 2.0 mL centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand, add 1.5 mL of 80% ethanol (use freshly prepared 80% ethanol equilibrated to room temperature), rotate the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand, wait until all magnetic beads are attracted to the side of the tube wall against the magnetic stand, then rotate the centrifuge tube again to allow the magnetic beads to be re-attracted to the other side to wash them. Let it stand for 30 s, then carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 5）重复步骤4）一次；
en: 5) Repeat step 4) once;
