zh: 6)  将离心管保持在磁力架上，室温风干 5-8 min，直至磁珠表面无反光、无开裂；
en: 6) Keep the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand and air-dry at room temperature for 5-8 min, until the surface of the magnetic beads shows no reflection or cracking;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 7) 先加 22 μL Nuclease-Free Water 回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置 5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置 3-5 min，直至液体变澄清；
en: 7) Add 22 μL of Nuclease-Free Water to resuspend, vortex to mix, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, centrifuge briefly, and place on a magnetic rack for 3-5 min until the liquid becomes clear;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 8) 将上清（~21 μL cDNA）转移到新的 0.2 mL PCR 管中；
en: 8) Transfer the supernatant (~21 μL of cDNA) to a new 0.2 mL PCR tube;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 9) 再将 22 μL Nuclease-Free Water 加入步骤 7） 磁珠中二次回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置 5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置 3-5 min，直至液体变澄清；
en: 9) Add another 22 μL of Nuclease-Free Water to the magnetic beads from step 7) to resuspend again, vortex to mix, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, centrifuge briefly, and place on a magnetic rack for 3-5 min until the liquid becomes clear;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 10) 将上清（~21 μL cDNA）转移至步骤 8） 所示的 PCR 管中，合并总体积~42 μL。
en: 10) Transfer the supernatant (~21 μL of cDNA) to the PCR tube indicated in step 8), combining for a total volume of ~42 μL.

zh: 移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠；如果管盖上有泡沫，建议用 80% 乙醇清洗并将液体加回离心管。

zh: 使用空气罐尽可能地吹去垫圈、上盖、底座、芯片载体表面的杂质或碎屑，确保物料表面无肉眼可见灰尘、颗粒等污染物，避免后续组装时影响密封性或损坏芯片。（图1 以清洁芯片载体为例）
en: Use an air duster to blow away any impurities or debris from the surfaces of the gasket, top cover, base, and chip carrier as thoroughly as possible. Ensure that the surfaces of these components are free of any visible dust, particles, or other contaminants to avoid compromising the seal or damaging the chip during subsequent assembly. (Figure 1 shows the cleaning of the chip carrier as an example.)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 将垫圈的定位孔与上盖的定位柱对齐，缓慢套合（图2），组成载具上半部分（图 3）。组装过程中需全程观察垫圈状态，确保无扭曲、褶皱或变形，若发现异常需立即调整垫圈，防止后续使用过程中密封不良。
en: Align the positioning holes of the gasket with the positioning posts of the upper cover, and slowly fit them together (Figure 2) to assemble the upper half of the carrier (Figure 3). Observe the state of the gasket throughout the assembly process to ensure there is no twisting, creasing, or deformation. If any abnormality is found, adjust the gasket immediately to prevent poor sealing during subsequent use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 手持芯片载体侧面（避免触碰芯片表面），芯片表面朝上（图4）。
en: Hold the sides of the chip carrier (avoid touching the chip surface), with the chip surface facing up (Figure 4).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 将芯片载体倾斜放置于底座上（图5），随后将大拇指轻放于芯片载体 1、4 位底端侧面（图6）；缓慢推动芯片载体从底座数字端向非数字端移动（图7），直至芯片载体抵住载具底座的两个活动拨片。
en: Place the chip carrier at an angle on the base (Figure 5), then gently place your thumbs on the sides of the bottom of the chip carrier at positions 1 and 4 (Figure 6); slowly push the chip carrier from the numerical end to the non-numerical end of the base (Figure 7) until the chip carrier is held against the two movable catches of the carrier base.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 轻轻向下按压芯片载体（图8），使其完全卡入底座卡槽内组成完整的载具下半部分（图9 以Chip N dual 为例 ），注意此过程中勿触碰芯片表面。
en: Gently press down on the chip carrier (Figure 8) until it snaps completely into the base slot to form the complete lower part of the carrier (Figure 9, taking Chip N dual as an example). Note: Do not touch the chip surface during this process.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 关键注意事项：卡入后需目视确认芯片载体与底座保持水平平行（图10），若存在倾斜（图11），需取出芯片载体重复载具下半部分组装过程，直至芯片载体安装正确，否则可能误操作导致玻片碎裂。
en: Critical Note: After snapping it into place, visually confirm that the chip carrier is horizontally parallel to the base (Figure 10). If it is tilted (Figure 11), remove the chip carrier and repeat the lower carrier assembly process until it is installed correctly; otherwise, incorrect operation may lead to slide breakage.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 图11 芯片载体与底座不平行图10 芯片载体与底座平行
en: Figure 11: Chip carrier not parallel to base; Figure 10: Chip carrier parallel to base.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 请勿在芯片载体上贴附任何包边标签或贴纸，以免因贴合不紧密，导致漏液，或因受力不均，导致芯片载体碎裂。
en: Do not attach any edge labels or stickers to the chip carrier to avoid leakage due to poor adhesion, or breakage of the chip carrier due to uneven force distribution.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 防护要求：全程避免接触芯片表面，以防损伤探针。
en: Protection requirements: Avoid contact with the chip surface throughout the process to prevent damage to the probes.

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 1）将初步组装好的载具上半部分（图3）与下半部分（图9）数字端的Tab1-3 分别对准（对准规则为：Tab1 对应Tab1-1），图13 。
en: 1) Align the preliminarily assembled upper part of the carrier (Figure 3) with the numeric side of the lower part (Figure 9), aligning Tab1-3 respectively (alignment rule: Tab1 corresponds to Tab1-1), Figure 13.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 2）对准后相互嵌套扣合，确保两者数字端完全匹配，扣合时需再次检查芯片载体与底座的相对位置，确保无偏移、倾斜；该版本载具具有防呆设计，如果误将数字端与非数字端匹配无法安装。扣合过程避免垫圈压到芯片（图14）。
en: 2) Once aligned, nest and snap them together, ensuring that the numeric sides of both parts fully match. During the snapping process, re-check the relative position of the chip carrier and the base to ensure there is no offset or tilting. This version of the carrier features a fool-proof design; it cannot be installed if the numeric side is incorrectly matched with the non-numeric side. During the snapping process, avoid the gasket pressing onto the chip (Figure 14).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 3）当载具上半部分与载具下半部分扣合过程中呈图15 的状态时，垫圈与玻片基本完全贴合。
en: 3) During the process of engaging the upper part of the carrier with the lower part, when it is in the state shown in Figure 15, the gasket and the slide are almost fully in contact.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 4）当继续扣合载具上半部分与下半部受到阻力时，双手大拇指按压载具非数字端（图16），直至听到“咔哒”一声，表明扣合到位。扣合后需检查三个卡扣处是否均完全扣合，防止使用时出现漏液、密封性不良或载具中途弹开等问题。装好后整体四个反应槽朝上（图17）。
en: 4) When you continue to engage the upper and lower parts of the carrier and encounter resistance, use both thumbs to press the non-numbered end of the carrier (Figure 16) until you hear a "click," which indicates that it is fully engaged. After engagement, check that all three snaps are fully engaged to prevent issues such as leakage, poor sealing, or the carrier popping open during use. Once assembled, the unit should be positioned with the four reaction wells facing upward (Figure 17).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 如果扣合困难，先检查底座与芯片载体是否安装止确，安装不正确需调整后扣合( 否则玻片碎裂)；安装正确仍无法扣合，借助辅助工具或置于桌上扣合。
en: If it is difficult to snap together, first check whether the base and the chip carrier are installed correctly. If installed incorrectly, adjust them before snapping together (otherwise the slide will break); if they are installed correctly but still cannot be snapped together, use assistive tools or place them on a table to snap them together.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 如V3 载具将用于Go Spatial 设备，则完成载具整体组装后即可上机，无需进行第三章的操作。
en: If the V3 carrier is to be used for the Go Spatial device, it can be loaded onto the instrument after the overall assembly of the carrier is completed, and the operations in Chapter 3 are not required.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 按需向应反应槽内添加对应试剂。添加试剂过程需确保不干扰其他反应槽；试剂铺满芯片；试剂无溅出（更详细的操作参考对应试剂盒内说明书）。
en: Add the corresponding reagents into the reaction wells as needed. During the reagent addition process, ensure no interference with other reaction wells; the reagent should cover the chip surface; and there should be no splashing of reagents (refer to the manual provided with the corresponding kit for more detailed operating procedures).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 加液过程：向反应槽内加液时为避免液体聚集在芯片单侧，采取分别向芯片上、下两侧加入二分之一总体积量的试剂，加液时移液器与芯片距离较近，注意不要划伤组织，避免高速加液冲击芯片表面，确保试剂覆盖全芯片（图18）。
en: Liquid addition process: To avoid liquid accumulation on one side of the chip when adding reagents to the reaction chamber, dispense one-half of the total reagent volume onto the upper and lower sides of the chip, respectively. Keep the pipette close to the chip during dispensing, taking care not to scratch the tissue. Avoid high-speed dispensing that impacts the chip surface, and ensure the reagent covers the entire chip (Fig. 18).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 贴合操作：将压敏膜的白色背纸剥离后迅速对准载具上盖（图19 左），一次性贴合到位，确保压敏膜完全覆盖载具，且与载具四周紧密贴合。注意压敏膜居中贴合，尽量使其边缘超出载具上盖凸台（避免使用过程中反应槽试剂过量挥发）。贴合后压敏膜与载具上盖存在较多气泡，可见明显反光（图19 右）。
en: Bonding operation: After peeling off the white backing paper from the pressure-sensitive film, quickly align it with the carrier cover (Fig. 19, left) and bond it in place in one motion. Ensure the pressure-sensitive film completely covers the carrier and fits tightly around its perimeter. Note that the film should be centered, and try to have its edges extend beyond the raised rim of the carrier cover (to prevent excessive evaporation of reagents from the reaction chamber during use). After bonding, numerous bubbles may exist between the pressure-sensitive film and the carrier cover, appearing as distinct reflections (Fig. 19, right).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 2. 压敏膜贴合
en: 2. Pressure-sensitive film lamination
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 图19 左图19 右
en: Figure 19 Left, Figure 19 Right
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 将压敏膜与载具间的气泡尽可能完全排出，确保反应槽腔体内处于相对隔绝状态，防止不同芯片相互干扰。气泡基本去除后反光点消失（图 21）。
en: Remove bubbles between the pressure-sensitive film and the carrier as completely as possible to ensure that the reaction chamber is in a relatively isolated state, preventing interference between different chips. Once bubbles are mostly removed, the reflective spots should disappear (Figure 21).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 孵育过程中需保持载具放置平稳，禁止碰撞、晃动载具。
en: During the incubation process, the carrier must be placed stably; do not bump or shake the carrier.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 孵育结束后小心取出载具，用手指捏住压敏膜的一角，缓慢、平稳地向一侧撕扯，过程中另一只手固定载具保持载具稳定（图22）。确保反应试剂不溅出，避免污染或试剂损失。
en: After incubation, carefully remove the chip carrier. Pinch a corner of the pressure-sensitive film with your fingers and slowly and steadily peel it off to one side, while using the other hand to secure the chip carrier and keep it stable (Figure 22). Ensure that the reaction reagent does not splash to avoid contamination or reagent loss.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 4. 压敏膜移除
en: 4. Pressure-Sensitive Film Removal
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 气泡去除：使用干净的平面状物体（如硅胶刮板、塑料卡片；禁止使用尖锐物体，防止压敏膜破损，导致密封失效），从载具中心向四周缓慢刮动（图20）。
en: Bubble removal: Use a clean, flat object (e.g., silicone squeegee, plastic card; do not use sharp objects to prevent damage to the pressure-sensitive film, which could lead to seal failure) and slowly scrape from the center of the carrier towards the edges (Figure 20).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 使用移液枪将载具反应槽内试剂的试剂尽可能吸出，避免枪头触碰芯片。
en: Use a pipette to aspirate as much reagent as possible from the carrier's reaction well, avoiding contact between the pipette tip and the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 如需拆卸载具，可在试剂移除后进行，防止拆卸过程试剂飞溅。
en: If it is necessary to disassemble the carrier, do so after reagent removal to prevent reagent splashing during the disassembly process.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 如需按照流程进行后续孵育，载具更换试剂按照“三. 载具使用”过程中1-5 的步骤操作，直至最终反应结束。
en: If subsequent incubation is required according to the protocol, follow steps 1-5 in "III. Carrier Usage" to exchange reagents for the carrier until the final reaction is complete.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 残胶处理：载具经过高/ 低温孵育，压敏膜可能残留胶迹在载具表面，导致后续使用过程密封性能降低，此时可用尖头镊子去除残胶，清洁过程中需避开反应槽，防止向槽内引入污染。
en: Residual Adhesive Removal: After the cassette has undergone high/low-temperature incubation, residue from the pressure-sensitive film may remain on the cassette surface, resulting in reduced sealing performance during subsequent use. In this case, use pointed tweezers to remove the residual adhesive. During the cleaning process, avoid the reaction wells to prevent introducing contamination into them.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Chip Carrier User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 将载具整体倒扣于手掌心，确保载具稳定，芯片载体朝下（避免直接接触手掌），如图24 所示。
en: Invert the entire carrier onto your palm, ensuring it is stable and the chip carrier is facing down (to avoid direct contact with the palm), as shown in Figure 24.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 推荐采购Stereo-seq V3 载具拆卸工具【货号：303TA30011】（图26），使用拆卸辅助工具操作。
en: It is recommended to purchase the Stereo-seq V3 Cassette Disassembly Tool [Cat. No.: 303TA30011] (Figure 26) and use the disassembly aid tool for operation.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 用其余四指分别扣住载具非数字端Tab4-6 处的上盖与底座间隙，手指缓慢弯曲，将上盖部分向外抠，见图25 所示。过程中会听到卡扣脱离的 “哒哒” 声，持续操作直至三个卡扣均完全脱离。
en: Use the remaining four fingers to hook the gap between the Stereo-seq V3 Cassette Lid and the Stereo-seq V3 Cassette Base at Tabs 4-6 on the non-numeric end of the cassette. Slowly curl your fingers and pry the lid section outwards, as shown in Figure 25. During the process, you will hear a "click-click" sound as the snaps disengage. Continue until all three snaps are completely disengaged.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 1. 载具上盖与底座拆卸
en: 1. Disassembly of the Stereo-seq V3 Cassette
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 1.1 拆卸方式一：徒手操作
en: 1.1 Disassembly Method 1: Manual Operation
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 1.2 拆卸方式二：借助拆卸工具（可选）
en: 1.2 Disassembly Method 2: Using Disassembly Tools (Optional)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 使用方式如下：载具倒扣于桌面，将拆卸工具垂直嵌入底座非数字端扣合处（Tab4-6），注意需要将拆卸工具的齿分别与Tab4-6 对准，如图27 所示。
en: Usage instructions are as follows: Place the carrier upside down on the table and insert the disassembly tool vertically into the engagement points on the non-numbered side of the base (Tab4-6). Note that the teeth of the disassembly tool must be aligned with Tab4-6 respectively, as shown in Figure 27.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 手握住拆卸工具上方，手掌用力向下按压拆卸工具，拆卸工具完全压入后即可取出拆卸工具（图28）。上盖与底座已分离。
en: Hold the top of the disassembly tool, use your palm to press it down firmly, and then remove the disassembly tool once it is fully inserted (Figure 28). The top cover and the base are now separated.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Chip Carrier User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 分离保护：Tab4-6 完全脱离后，小心将载具翻转为正面朝上（芯片表面朝上），缓慢分离上盖与底座（图29）。
en: Separation protection: After Tab 4-6 are completely disengaged, carefully turn the carrier over so that the front side is facing up (chip surface facing up), and slowly separate the top cover from the base (Figure 29).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 分离保护：Tab4-6 完全脱离后，小心将载具翻转为正面朝上（芯片表面朝上），缓慢分离上盖与底座。过程中，左手食指轻轻抵住芯片载体手柄端侧面（图31），分离时避免芯片载体与底座脱离，芯片载体掉落损伤芯片。
en: Separation protection: After Tab 4-6 are completely disengaged, carefully turn the carrier over so that the front side is facing up (chip surface facing up), and slowly separate the top cover from the base. During this process, gently press your left index finger against the side of the handle end of the chip carrier (Figure 31) to prevent the chip carrier from separating from the base and falling, which could damage the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 芯片载体与垫圈黏附较紧，分离后芯片载体会附着在载具上半部分。小心将垫圈从上盖取出后，一手按压住芯片载体，一手将垫圈与芯片载体分离。避免接触到芯片表面。
en: The chip carrier is adhered tightly to the gasket, and after separation, the chip carrier will remain attached to the upper part of the carrier. After carefully removing the gasket from the top cover, use one hand to press down on the chip carrier and the other hand to separate the gasket from the chip carrier. Avoid touching the chip surface.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 2.1 （加热后）垫圈与芯片载体玻片黏附较紧的情况下拆卸
en: 2.1 Disassembly when the gasket is firmly adhered to the chip carrier slide (after heating)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 2.2 （室温孵育下）垫圈与芯片载体无黏附情况下拆卸
en: 2.2 Disassembly when the gasket is not adhered to the chip carrier (under room temperature incubation)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 图31  拆卸过程左手食指抵住芯片载体图示
en: Figure 31 Illustration of the left index finger holding against the chip carrier during the disassembly process
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 注意事项：需根据实际情况调整拆卸方式，确保芯片表面无损伤。
en: Precautions: The disassembly method must be adjusted based on the actual situation to ensure that the chip surface is not damaged.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier Instructions for Use
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 载具下半部分拆分：双手持载具下半部分，大拇指于芯片载体1，4 位底部侧面推动芯片载体从数字端向非数字端移动，使芯片载体从底座中的玻片卡槽中脱离。小心取出芯片载体（手持芯片载体手柄端，防止污染芯片）
en: Disassembling the lower part of the carrier: Hold the lower part of the carrier with both hands, use your thumbs to push the chip carrier at the bottom side of positions 1 and 4, moving it from the digital end towards the non-digital end to release it from the slide slot in the base. Carefully remove the chip carrier (hold the chip carrier by its handle to avoid contaminating the chip).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Cassette User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 当流程中需要更换 V3 垫圈时，按照 “四、拆卸流程 ” 中“1”步骤操作，将V3 载具拆分为上半部分与下半部分，将载具上半部分的旧垫圈移除，需对上盖进行清洁，操作步骤如下：
en: When it is necessary to replace the V3 gasket during the process, follow the operations in step '1' of 'IV. Disassembly Procedure' to disassemble the V3 carrier into upper and lower parts, remove the old gasket from the upper part of the carrier, and clean the upper cover. The operation steps are as follows:
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 1. 75% 乙醇擦拭上盖去除表面残留试剂，使用洁净气瓶吹净表面残留75% 乙醇与杂质（该过程需避免在芯片载体上方操作）。
en: 1. Wipe the upper cover with 75% ethanol to remove residual reagents from the surface, and use a clean air duster to blow away any residual 75% ethanol and impurities on the surface (this process should be performed away from above the chip carrier).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 2. 再根据“安装流程”更换新垫圈并重新组装即可，更换后需再次确认垫圈无变形、贴合紧密。
en: 2. Then, replace with a new gasket according to the "Installation Procedure" and reassemble. After replacement, ensure again that the gasket is not deformed and fits tightly.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Chip User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: V3 载具中可重复使用的部分为上盖与底座。转录组及透化套装内含不同规格的载具包，请使用套装内的载具进行实验。载具上盖、底架随试剂盒复用，禁止跨试剂盒/跨批次复用。
en: The reusable components of the V3 chip are the lid and the base. The Transcriptome and Tissue Optimization Kit contains chip packs of various specifications. Please use the chips included in the kit for experiments. The chip lid and base are to be reused only with the kit provided; cross-kit or cross-batch reuse is prohibited.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 如需重复使用，需对上盖与底座进行如下的清洁操作：
en: For reuse, the cover and base must be subjected to the following cleaning procedures:
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 1. 首先使用75% 乙醇浸泡10 min；
en: 1. First, immerse in 75% ethanol for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 2. 使用RO 水浸泡载具2 min；
en: 2. Immerse the carrier in RO water for 2 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 3. 将浸泡后载具使用55℃烘箱干燥或者气瓶吹干残余水分；
en: 3. Dry the carrier after soaking using a 55℃ oven or blow dry residual moisture with an air gun;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 4. 将清洁好的上盖、底座装入配件包或干净的自封袋，记录使用状态及日期。
en: 4. Place the cleaned upper cover and base into an accessory bag or a clean ziplock bag, and record the usage status and date.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书
